summary: Framing section for the Brain Platform: a single multi-tenant "company brain" built purely on Cloudflare primitives (no Convex), unifying gbrain-cf's epistemic/cited-search depth, openbrains' structural isolation/governance, and cf-graph's durable ingestion. v1 deliberately targets 1-2 internal-dogfood tenants on a SINGLE shared D1 with two base Vectorize indexes; the full isolation model ships in v1 but horizontal scale-out (D1/Vectorize shard fan-out) is deferred to Phase N with `tenant_shards` columns resolving to one shard. Isolation is a STRUCTURAL property via `Scoped*` chokepoints (ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2), not a per-query filter convention; memory is governed (trust grades, audit, citations, recall traces). This section owns the canonical `Principal` contract (where tenancy meets personas) but defers the data model to §3, isolation internals to §5, search pipeline to §4.3, and backfill spine to §6 — capture names/contracts from those, not invented internals.

components.name: packages/shared
components.purpose: Single identity/scope contract — the `Principal` interface; the one canonical definition referenced by §2/§7/§9.

components.name: packages/db (ScopedDB)
components.purpose: Tenant-scoped D1 access chokepoint; raw unscoped `env.DB` query outside this package fails lint. Hosts the D1 correctness gate (drop-don't-error re-check) and predicate methods like readFacts/getChunksByIds/hydrateChunks/listDocuments.

components.name: ScopedVectorize
components.purpose: Namespace-by-construction Vectorize wrapper that stamps `namespace=tenantId` on every upsert/query so a forgotten namespace is impossible (callers never build raw queries).

components.name: ScopedR2
components.purpose: Tenant-prefixed R2 access chokepoint for bodies/transcripts.

components.name: MCP server (Durable Object, MyMCP pattern)
components.purpose: The ONLY Durable Object use in v1 — MCP server instance per cf-graph MyMCP pattern; stamps readOnly from role/MCP key. Not DO-per-tenant working memory (deferred).

components.name: brain CLI
components.purpose: `brain` command-line client with OAuth device flow; CLI auth/token tables ported from cf-graph cli-tokens.

components.name: Dashboard (TanStack Start + shadcn)
components.purpose: Web dashboard surface; one of the three product surfaces. Shows scale-headroom observability (D1 size, per-shard write-QPS, per-index vector count).

components.name: Workers backend
components.purpose: CF Workers backend; resolves Principal at the edge (resolvePrincipal) and threads it below auth — never a bare token below the edge.

components.name: Importer SDK
components.purpose: Platform-neutral importer/source SDK lifted wholesale from openbrains packages/ingest; sources include documents, GitHub repos, Gmail, OB1, chat-session exports.

components.name: Enumerator Workflow
components.purpose: Stage 1 of the three-stage ingestion spine — enumerates source items, resumable from saved cursor/anchor.

components.name: Batch-Ingest Workflow
components.purpose: Stage 3 of the ingestion spine — ingests batched items idempotently (deterministic instance id ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}).

components.name: brain-backfill Queue
components.purpose: Stage 2 of the ingestion spine, decoupling enumeration from batch ingest.

components.name: Idle-promotion cron
components.purpose: Sweeps idle sessions to recover missed Stop-hooks; keys on sessions.last_activity_at (not ended_at).

dataModel.name: brain-chunks
dataModel.notes: Base chunk vector index, 1024d/cosine (bge-m3 locked — 1024d inferred from bge-m3 lock). namespace=tenantId stamped by ScopedVectorize. trust_grade is NEVER a Vectorize field; team_id/scope/visibility carried as metadata; metadata re-checked against D1 row. Shared across all tenant namespaces (10M-vector ceiling is per-index, non-binding at 1-2 tenants).

dataModel.name: brain-entities
dataModel.notes: Entity vector index, 1024d/cosine, provisioned in v1 alongside brain-chunks. v1 uses deterministic entity resolution only; Phase 3.5 adds nearest-vector dedup on top of this index.

dataModel.name: orgs / teams / memberships
dataModel.notes: Tenancy spine org→team→user→scope. membership.role ∈ owner|admin|member|readonly; allowedScopes grant (default '*'). Defined fully in §3 — capture names only here. Every isolatable row carries tenant_id NOT NULL.

dataModel.name: sessions / session_turns
dataModel.notes: Net-new first-class session store (no source system has one). last_activity_at refreshed on every capture_turn drives idle-promotion; ended_at may be NULL. Three ingress paths: live MCP capture_turn, batch importer, webhook /ingest. Promoted to typed facts.

dataModel.name: facts
dataModel.notes: Typed facts (ported from gbrain-cf). trust_grade ∈ instruction|evidence|draft; promoted facts carry source_session_id, written as evidence. Deterministic entity key (tenant_id, kind, canonical_name) + alias union. Hot facts live in D1 + FTS5 (not DO).

dataModel.name: memory_use_policy (sidecar)
dataModel.notes: Holds trust_grade and access tier — deliberately KEPT OUT of Vectorize so trust_grade is never a vector field (§3.2/§5.2).

dataModel.name: memory_review
dataModel.notes: Human-confirmed review gate; promotion to instruction trust grade requires a memory_review row. Agent writeback cannot self-promote.

dataModel.name: memory_audit
dataModel.notes: Append-only audit row written in the SAME db.batch as each change; append-only enforced by banned-import lint; periodically exported append-only to R2 (tamper-evidence backstop). A growth term driving the 6 GB shard trigger.

dataModel.name: memory_recall_traces
dataModel.notes: One trace per kept recall hit. Writes decoupled from read path (ctx.waitUntil/separate store) since D1 is single-writer. Growth bounded by a retention/rollup policy (Open Question, §7).

dataModel.name: token_spend
dataModel.notes: App-level cost accounting; pre-checks tenant budget vs MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD before env.AI.run, returns 429. This is the enforcing spend cap for the all-@cf/ v1 model set.

dataModel.name: chunks
dataModel.notes: Index rows holding chunks.content + external-content FTS5 index built on it — the dominant D1 byte term (not offloaded bodies). D1 also holds markdown_preview; full bodies offloaded to R2.

dataModel.name: CLI-token + API-key tables
dataModel.notes: CLI auth tables ported from cf-graph cli-tokens; API keys (bk_ prefix, SHA-256 hash) tenant-bound with stored scopes JSON→capabilities; HMAC machine tokens (bdev_ prefix) tenant baked in.

dataModel.name: tenant_shards (columns)
dataModel.notes: Forward-compat sharding columns present in v1 but resolve to ONE shard; future scale-out is a routing change not a rewrite. NON-BINDING at 1-2 tenants.

dataModel.name: bodies / transcripts (body_r2_key)
dataModel.notes: Full document markdown and full session transcripts live in R2 keyed by body_r2_key, tenant-prefixed keys. D1 holds only markdown_preview + index rows. Also the append-only export target for memory_audit.

dataModel.name: brain_snapshots / page_versions (DEFERRED)
dataModel.notes: Frozen-snapshot injection substrate (brain_snapshots.manifest pinning immutable version ids; page_versions from gbrain-cf) — explicitly NOT v1; get_session_context(snapshot_id) accepted but documented as deferred.

algorithms: resolvePrincipal() at the edge — 3-branch resolution: (1) OAuth/Clerk JWT sub=userId → membership lookup → {tenantId,teamIds,role,allowedScopes}; (2) HMAC machine token (bdev_ prefix) → tenant baked in; (3) API key (bk_ prefix, SHA-256 hash) → tenant-bound, stored scopes JSON→capabilities, allowedScopes defaults to '*'. Never a bare token below the edge.

Two orthogonal axes kept separate: allowedScopes (data partition, read by ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize) vs capabilities read/write/admin (read by scopeSatisfied/readOnly). Earlier merged-`scopes` bug removed.

Hybrid search pipeline (§4.3): embed(query) (+optional LLM expansion) → [FTS5 bm25 ∥ Vectorize namespace=tenant] → RRF (K=60, normalize-by-max) → title/trust boosts → bge-reranker-base rerank (degradable to RRF order on binding error) → top-k. embed() returns null never throws. FTS sanitizer from cf-graph. Thresholds 0.5/0.85.

think synthesis (ported from gbrain-cf): SYNTH_SYSTEM enforces cite-the-slug / say-what's-missing; dedupeSlugs builds citations; empty-evidence → answer:'' + populated gaps[] + warnings:['no_evidence']; model down → warnings:['llm_unavailable'] + raw evidence; net-new gap evidence_evicted:<n> when synthesis drops lower-ranked evidence to fit context window.

Ingestion spine: Enumerator Workflow → brain-backfill Queue → Batch-Ingest Workflow. Resumable from saved cursor/anchor; idempotent via deterministic instance id ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}; re-upload unchanged content → skipped.

Session lifecycle: capture (3 ingress paths) → finalize → promote to typed facts (trust_grade=evidence, source_session_id). Missed Stop-hook recovered by idle-promotion cron keyed on last_activity_at. Re-finalizing an edited session cleanly replaces prior promoted facts (no duplicate append).

D1 correctness gate: after every vector/FTS hit, the D1 row re-check drops any id whose live tenant_id doesn't match AND any out-of-allowedScopes id — silently (no existence leak / drop-don't-error). Vector arm closes scope at this gate (AND (allowedScopes='*' OR scope IN (...))), not in the Vectorize call.
Governance write: every write + its memory_audit row in one db.batch (no interactive cross-await D1 txns). Every kept recall hit writes a memory_recall_trace.
token_spend pre-check: pre-checks tenant budget vs MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD and returns 429 BEFORE issuing env.AI.run. Workers AI request-RATE limits handled separately (degrade-or-queue, not 429).
Entity resolution (v1, deterministic only): key (tenant_id, kind, canonical_name) + alias union. No cross-session semantic dedup until Phase 3.5.
invariants: Every isolatable row carries tenant_id NOT NULL; every vector is namespaced namespace=tenantId; no single-tenant shortcuts even with one user.
namespace=tenantId is mandatory and namespace=userId is REJECTED (userId-namespacing physically blocks team-wide recall).

All tenant-data reads/writes flow ONLY through ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2 chokepoints — enforced by a banned-import ESLint rule and blocking CI isolation tests; a raw unscoped env.DB query outside packages/db fails lint.

Isolation does NOT rest on the Vectorize namespace (CF does not document it as a security boundary). It rests on (a) un-omittable ScopedVectorize wiring and (b) the mandatory D1 row re-check that drops cross-tenant ids. Both must be preserved.
trust_grade is NEVER a Vectorize field — it lives in the memory_use_policy sidecar in D1 (a field deliberately NOT indexed in the vector store).
Principal's two axes never conflated: allowedScopes (data partition) vs capabilities (read/write/admin) — they come from different sources and are consumed by different code.
D1 re-check drops cross-tenant AND out-of-allowedScopes ids SILENTLY (no existence leak); an explicit out-of-grant opts.scope is rejected 403.

Intra-tenant visibility (RLS) is structural via ScopedDB chokepoint: one user's private instruction-fact / private session chunk is never recalled/searched/thought/injected into another user's session; team tier enforced (teammate yes, non-teammate no) on BOTH facts and hybrid arms.
Recall-completeness under topK pressure: a restricted principal must still recall its OWN granted-scope content even when it ranks below the tenant-wide Vectorize top-K.
Agent writeback CANNOT set instruction (hard-wired evidence); promotion to instruction requires a human-confirmed memory_review row.
Every write emits a matching memory_audit row in the SAME db.batch; every kept recall hit writes a memory_recall_trace. memory_audit is append-only (lint-enforced) and exported append-only to R2.
No interactive cross-await D1 transactions — atomicity is via db.batch([...]) only.
bge-m3 1024d is locked; cross-model vector co-mingling is forbidden — foreign-dimension (qwen3, OB1/OpenAI 1536d) vectors are RE-EMBEDDED, never copied (emit embeddingModel:'pending').
Bodies/transcripts offloaded to R2 (body_r2_key); D1 holds only markdown_preview + index rows. The 6 GB shard trigger is driven by chunks.content + FTS5 + audit/recall growth, not bodies.

token_spend pre-check returns 429 BEFORE env.AI.run (the enforcing cap); AI Gateway spend limits do NOT cover the all-@cf/ neuron-billed v1 model set. All model calls still proxied through AI Gateway with tenant_id metadata.
Never a bare token below the edge: resolvePrincipal() runs once at the edge and Principal is threaded everywhere below auth.
readOnly MCP key/role cannot invoke any write tool.
No Convex anywhere; no AutoRAG/AI Search for the core; no DO-per-tenant working memory; no frozen-snapshot injection in v1.

tenant_shards columns ship in v1 but resolve to ONE shard (single shared D1); Vectorize ceilings (10M vectors / 50k namespaces) and 6 GB D1 trigger are NON-BINDING at 1-2 tenants — documented Phase-N triggers, no sharding logic in v1.

decisions.question: Should a 'client' in the multi-client agency persona ever be a SEPARATE org (hard isolation for compliance) rather than a scope (soft, shared-tenant)? v1 default is scope; the hard-isolation variant is the D1-per-tenant path in §5e.
decisions.suggestedDefault: v1 default: client = scope (soft sub-partition under one agency tenant); tenant_id stays the hard boundary. Hard-isolation-as-separate-org is the documented §5e path, not built in v1.

decisions.question: Retention-or-rollup policy for memory_recall_traces and memory_audit growth (they, not offloaded bodies, drive the 6 GB shard trigger). Flagged as an Open Question in §7.
decisions.suggestedDefault: Bound growth with a retention/rollup policy; details deferred to §7. Not blocking for v1 build.

decisions.question: Per-model Workers AI request-RATE limits are explicitly-labeled conservative assumptions, unverified-until-staging and non-binding at 1-2 tenants (§5.1/§5f).
decisions.suggestedDefault: Treat documented rate limits as assumptions; verify at staging. Degrade-or-queue at embed()/gen()/rerank() chokepoints rather than 429-ing users.

summary: The Brain Platform is a single Cloudflare Worker (apps/api, Hono) exposing three request surfaces (REST, MCP, webhook) over a six-layer spine: edge/auth (resolve one Principal per request), API surfaces, tenant-agnostic service layer, a mandatory isolation layer (the ONLY path to tenant data, via Scoped* handles that hard-wire tenant_id), durable orchestration (Workflows + Queues + Cron), and raw CF primitives + AI. The defining invariant is that every byte of tenant data is reached through a Scoped* object that injects tenant_id at a single chokepoint; no raw env.DB/env.VECTORIZE/env.FILES binding is ever named in a service. v1 targets 1-2 tenants on a single shared D1 (no shard fan-out built) and a single set of provisioned Vectorize indexes. This section defines layer responsibilities, component ownership, and request lifecycles; schemas are deferred to s03 (data model) and s05 (isolation mechanics).

components.name: apps/api
components.purpose: Single Hono Worker: REST router + MCP DO + webhook + service layer + Workflows + Queue consumers. The whole backend.

components.name: apps/dashboard
components.purpose: TanStack Start + shadcn UI deployed on Workers (dashboard).

components.name: apps/cli (brain)
components.purpose: CLI client named `brain`.

components.name: packages/ingest
components.purpose: Importer SDK lifted from openbrains:packages/ingest with Convex orchestration dropped; implements Importer contract (begin/nextBatch/finalize), fingerprint+normalize, source adapters.

components.name: packages/db
components.purpose: Drizzle schema + migrations + ScopedDB. THE ONLY module permitted to import raw env.DB binding (enforced by ESLint banned-import per s05i).

components.name: packages/shared
components.purpose: Zod tool schemas + model constants; canonical Principal contract (s01.4).

components.name: MyMCP
components.purpose: MCP server instance + OAuth coordination ONLY — never the system of record. /mcp/<slug> rewrite, readOnly-gated write-tool registration.

components.name: IngestionWorkflow
components.purpose: Batch-Ingest: extract→chunk→store-chunks-batch(10)→embed-batch(50)→KG-batch(5)→finalize; per-phase retries/backoff; deterministic id ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}.

components.name: EnumeratorWorkflow
components.purpose: net-new; one instance per (tenantId, sourceId); drives openbrains Importer contract; each page one named step.do (resume on restart); enqueues references only, never embeds inline.

components.name: EntityExtractionWorkflow
components.purpose: batch-of-5 step.do with retries {limit:3, backoff:'exponential'}; entity/KG extraction.

components.name: SessionPromoteWorkflow
components.purpose: net-new; fact extraction → atomic writeback → chunk + embed; triggered by finalize_session / idle-session promotion.

components.name: brain-backfill
components.purpose: net-new Queue (+DLQ brain-backfill-dlq); per-message ack()/retry(); poison→DLQ after 5 retries; max_batch 10, retries 5.

components.name: brain-reembed
components.purpose: net-new Queue (+DLQ); cron-fed model/content-drift re-embed sweep; traffic tagged 'migration' in AI Gateway.

components.name: ScopedDB
components.purpose: Isolation constructor over Drizzle; injects AND tenant_id=? (+scope filter) into every query; resolves shard from tenant_shards (v1 = single shared D1); D1 substitute for RLS.

components.name: ScopedVectorize
components.purpose: Isolation constructor; hard-wires namespace=tenantId on every upsert/query; team_id/scope/visibility/embedding_model are filterable metadata within namespace; trust_grade deliberately NOT a metadata field.

components.name: ScopedR2
components.purpose: Isolation constructor; prefixes every key with ${tenantId}/.

components.name: resolvePrincipal
components.purpose: L1 resolver: OAuth/Clerk JWT | HMAC machine token (bdev_) | API key (bk_); adds membership lookup to attach tenantId/teamIds/role → Principal.

dataModel.name: memberships
dataModel.notes: net-new (no mined project has one). Maps user→tenant; attaches tenantId/teamIds/role during membership lookup in resolvePrincipal. Also resolves MCP slug → {tenantId, scope}.

dataModel.name: api_keys
dataModel.notes: tenant-bound; SHA-256 hash lookup of bk_ key; fields read_only, expires_at; stored scopes JSON → Principal.capabilities (NOT allowedScopes, which defaults to '*').

dataModel.name: tenant_shards
dataModel.notes: shard binding resolution table read by ScopedDB; v1 always resolves to single shared D1 (no fan-out built; deferred per s05e).

dataModel.name: documents
dataModel.notes: index/preview row only — body NEVER stored in D1 (goes to R2). Fields: tenant_id, r2_key, markdown_preview, status (pending→processing→indexed), fingerprint (sha256(normalizeForFingerprint(md)), used for dedup).

dataModel.name: chunks + chunks_fts
dataModel.notes: chunks carry tenant_id; chunks_fts is FTS5 virtual table maintained by triggers; bm25/MATCH cannot carry tenant_id so hits JOIN-back to tenant-scoped base table. Stamp embedded_at/embedding_model per row.

dataModel.name: sessions / session_turns
dataModel.notes: first-class session store (s06). session_turns lean row {tenant_id, session_id, idx, role, content} or R2 ref for long turns; sessions has turn_count, updated_at.

dataModel.name: memory_audit
dataModel.notes: {tenant_id, user_id, action, target}; written in SAME db.batch as the mutation (audit-in-same-batch invariant from openbrains writeback.ts).

dataModel.name: memory_use_policy
dataModel.notes: sidecar (s03.2/s05.2) that solely holds trust_grade; LEFT-JOINed at read with default 'evidence'; trust promotion never rewrites a vector.

dataModel.name: memory_recall_traces
dataModel.notes: one row per kept hit during think (via ScopedDB); models openbrains recall.ts.

dataModel.name: backfill_runs
dataModel.notes: cursor/anchor state per run; backfill_runs.cursor updated via ScopedDB; anchor advances ONLY on a clean pass (gbrain anchor discipline).

dataModel.name: enumerator run row
dataModel.notes: optimistic conditional claim UPDATE ... SET status='running' WHERE id=? AND status=? AND updated_at=? (prevents double-run) + STALE_RUNNING_MS reclaim; retained only for enumerator-run row (Queue owns message dispatch).

dataModel.name: brain-chunks
dataModel.notes: 1024d / cosine; chunk search (s06.6). namespace=tenantId hard-wired; metadata: team_id, scope, visibility, embedding_model. trust_grade NOT present.

dataModel.name: brain-entities
dataModel.notes: 1024d / cosine; entity search (s06.7). Same namespace/metadata discipline.

dataModel.name: bodies/transcripts
dataModel.notes: tenant-prefixed keys ${tenantId}/... e.g. docs/${id}, sessions/${id}/turn-${idx}, backfill/${runId}/${fingerprint}. All bodies/transcripts live here, never in D1.

dataModel.name: OAUTH_KV
dataModel.notes: backs workers-oauth-provider (OAuth state/coordination).

dataModel.name: MyMCP DO
dataModel.notes: MCP server instance + OAuth coordination state only; explicitly NOT system of record; per-tenant DO working memory is deferred/out-of-scope.

CLI: brain
algorithms: resolvePrincipal: try OAuth2.1/Clerk JWT (jose jwtVerify sub→userId) | HMAC bdev_ machine token (tenant in claims) | bk_ API key (SHA-256 hash→api_keys row) → then membership lookup attaches tenantId/teamIds/role → single Principal; bare token NEVER crosses below L1

Post-query D1 re-check (correctness gate): after every vector query AND every FTS5 MATCH, JOIN matched ids back to live ScopedDB rows and re-check tenant_id/scope/deleted_at (and scope ∈ allowedScopes when restricted); cross-tenant + out-of-grant ids silently dropped (no existence leak). Explicit out-of-grant scope arg → 403 at Scoped* entry.

search (cheap hybrid): embed(q) bge-m3 null-safe degrade → FTS bm25 arm ∥ Vectorize arm (ns=tenantId) → both id sets JOIN-back re-check → rrfFusion(K=60, normalize-by-max) → applyTitleBoost(1.25) → top-k

think: expandQuery (llama, opt-in, 2-3 phrasings) → hybrid per phrasing (tenant-filtered + D1 re-check) → rrfFusion merge → top-N (~40) → bge-reranker-base {query, contexts:[{text}], top_k} index-mapped/degradable → top-k (8-12) → token-budget guard against ~24k llama-3.3-70b window (reserve system+question+answer headroom, fill highest-rerank-first, overflow→warnings/gaps never mid-doc truncation, single oversized hit summarized-then-synthesized) → cited synthesis {answer,evidence[],citations[],gaps[],warnings} + memory_recall_traces row per kept hit

ingest: ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES allowlist → ScopedR2.put body → fingerprint=sha256(normalizeForFingerprint(md)) dedup (match→{skipped}) → ScopedDB.insert documents (preview, status:pending) → INGESTION_WORKFLOW.create(id=ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}). Workflow: status→processing → extract-text (R2.get→toMarkdown PDF/DOCX/HTML, 3 retries) → chunk (paragraph-pack md / sliding 512-64 PDF) → store-chunks-batch(10) → embed-batch(50)→ScopedVectorize.upsert(ns=tenant)+stamp embedded_at/embedding_model → KG-batch(5)→EntityExtractionWorkflow → finalize status→indexed

backfill (3-stage): EnumeratorWorkflow(tenantId,sourceId) begin(importer.begin resumeCursor=anchor) → loop step.do(page-n): nextBatch(cursor); per item ScopedR2.put payload + brain-backfill.send({tenantId,sourceId,runId,kind,payloadRef,fingerprint}) references-only; backfill_runs.cursor=nextCursor; finalize advances anchor ONLY on clean pass. brain-backfill consumer (max_batch10,retries5,DLQ): ack/retry per msg; heavy item→IngestionWorkflow deterministic id (idempotent). brain-reembed: rows where embedding_model!=bge-m3 OR embedded_at IS NULL OR updated_at>embedded_at → re-embed+restamp

capture_turn: ScopedDB.batch([INSERT session_turns, UPSERT sessions turn_count+1, INSERT memory_audit]) single D1 batch (no interactive tx); big turn→ScopedR2; embedding deferred to finalize→SessionPromoteWorkflow; return 202

Degradation contract: every AI/Vectorize-dependent arm tolerates missing binding and falls back (keyword-only search; RRF-order w/o rerank; evidence-without-synthesis) and NEVER throws; embed() returns null on failure
invariants: Every byte of tenant data is reached through a Scoped* object that hard-wires tenant_id (the single chokepoint that makes the platform multi-tenant).
No L3 service ever names a raw env.DB / env.VECTORIZE / env.FILES binding — only Scoped* handles; enforced by ESLint banned-import (s05i); raw bindings importable ONLY inside packages/db.
A bare token NEVER crosses below L1; everything below receives a Principal.
ScopedVectorize hard-wires namespace=tenantId on every upsert/query so omission is physically impossible (namespace=userId would block team-shared recall).

trust_grade is DELIBERATELY NOT a Vectorize metadata field (never index/filter/upsert); lives only in memory_use_policy sidecar, LEFT-JOINed at read default 'evidence' — a trust promotion never rewrites a vector.

Post-query D1 re-check on BOTH arms: vector matches AND FTS5 bm25 hits must JOIN-back to tenant-scoped base table and re-check tenant_id/scope/deleted_at before any row leaves; cross-tenant/out-of-grant ids silently dropped (no existence leak).
Explicit out-of-grant scope argument is rejected 403 at ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize entry (s07.3).
Bodies/transcripts are NEVER stored in D1 — only in R2 (tenant-prefixed); documents row holds preview only.
audit row written in the SAME db.batch as the mutation it records (D1 has no interactive transactions across awaits).

Internal hops use native Service/Workflow/Queue bindings, NOT an HTTP shared secret; handler still reconstructs Principal from explicit tenant_id and goes through Scoped* — bindings remove network surface but do NOT bypass isolation.
Workflow created with deterministic id ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint} — idempotent under at-least-once / duplicate delivery.
Backfill anchor advances ONLY on a clean pass, never on a degraded read.
EnumeratorWorkflow enqueues references only (payload→R2, ref in message) to stay under 10k-step and 1 MiB step-output caps.
Per-tenant spend enforced APP-SIDE: token_spend pre-check → 429 BEFORE env.AI.run; AI Gateway tenant_id metadata is attribution/observability only, NOT the enforcing cap for @cf/ models.
All Workers AI calls go through a provider factory (embed()/gen()/rerank() chokepoints), never env.AI.run directly from services — the only forward-compat seam.
D1 batch constants are limit-driven: CHUNK_DB_BATCH_SIZE=10 (D1 100 bound-param cap), EMBED_BATCH_SIZE=50, KG_BATCH_SIZE=5.
Optimistic conditional claim (UPDATE ... WHERE id=? AND status=? AND updated_at=?) prevents double-run of enumerator run row.
DO is MCP server instance + OAuth coordination ONLY — never the system of record.

summary: Consolidated authoritative data-model catalog for the Brain Platform, a Cloudflare-native multi-tenant memory system. Defines the full D1 relational schema (content, doc-graph, knowledge-graph, tenancy/auth, governance sidecars, sessions/facts, jobs/ops), two Vectorize V2 indexes, the R2 key scheme, KV usage, and one Durable Object class. The relational layer fuses three mined schemas (cf-graph Drizzle, gbrain SQL migrations, openbrains Convex) re-expressed as D1 DDL and re-scoped from single-tenant to an org→team→user→scope tenancy spine where org IS the tenant (id == tenant_id). The hard correctness theme is structural multi-tenant isolation: every isolatable row carries tenant_id, all access goes through ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2 choke-points that inject tenant_id+scope+visibility, FTS5 tables deliberately omit tenant_id (isolation via JOIN re-check), and trust_grade lives only in a sidecar (never on chunks/facts/vectors). Body bytes are offloaded to R2; D1 holds index+lean rows only. v1 runs single-shard (one shared D1, db_binding='DB').

algorithms: Tenant isolation choke-point: never hand-build WHERE; all reads/writes go through ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2 which inject tenant_id(+scope+visibility) so the predicate is un-omittable

Vector→D1 re-check: after every Vectorize query, re-JOIN kept ids to live chunks via getChunksByIds and re-check tenant_id/scope/visibility/deleted_at; silently drop cross-tenant/out-of-grant ids (no existence leak). D1 is the existence authority; Vectorize never read-back-confirmed (eventually consistent)
FTS isolation: FTS5 external-content tables carry no tenant_id (MATCH can't filter inside) — isolation is the JOIN re-check on the base table (§7.4)
Re-embed convergence: re-embed upserts the SAME nanoid id (converges, never duplicates); delete by id; staleness via updated_at > embedded_at (computeStale)

foldPartitionFilter: for restricted principals fold granted scope (single-grant) or visibility='world' INTO the Vectorize metadata filter so capped topK budget is spent inside the grant (recall-cliff fix); trust-grade boost runs POST-hydration on LEFT-JOINed sidecar value

Dedup: documents UNIQUE(tenant_id,scope,fingerprint); entities case-insensitive UNIQUE(tenant_id,COALESCE(scope,''),kind,lower(canonical_name)) + alias set-union; sessions content_hash=sha256(normalizeForFingerprint); doc_links COALESCE(origin_id,'') in unique key
Cost cap: embed()/gen()/rerank() pre-check active token_spend window; 429+Retry-After when over budget_neurons; neurons is the v1 billed unit
Body-offload: D1 holds index+lean rows + preview only (markdown_preview ≤2000 char, compiled_truth preview); full bytes in R2 via body_r2_key/r2_key/r2_offset

summary: Specifies the durable, multi-tenant write path: bytes from any source (uploads, pre-chunked payloads, webhooks, resumable backfill) become tenant-scoped, deduplicated, embedded, KG-extracted, dual-indexed rows in D1 + Vectorize + FTS5, with bodies in R2. The backbone is a near-verbatim port of cf-graph's step-resumable Cloudflare Workflow, re-scoped from workspace_id to tenant_id and adding per-row embedding-model/staleness stamping. Critical step-output design works around the 1 MiB non-stream step.do() cap by staging bodies/chunk content to R2 and returning only keys + lean metadata. Scope covers the write path up to "row searchable in both arms"; read/RRF/rerank is §4.3-read, the Queue/Enumerator backfill spine is §6, and isolation mechanics (Scoped*) are §5.

Reprocess escape hatch: delete old vectors/chunks then create `ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}-${Date.now()}`
Importer contract (begin/nextBatch/finalize) consumed by §6 Enumerator; proven by runImporterContract
Ingress dedup gate (pre-Workflow): findByFingerprint -> {documentId, status:'skipped'} on unchanged indexed doc
algorithms: Document dedup gate (pre-Workflow): fp=sha256(normalizeForFingerprint(markdown)); if existing indexed doc with same (tenant_id,fingerprint) -> log 'skipped', return without burning embeddings. Binary two-phase: cheap sha256(raw bytes) pre-check, then canonical markdown fp computed in extract-text step (mark 'duplicate' + abort if collision).

Idempotent trigger: deterministic instance id ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}; CF rejects duplicate while within retention (3d Free/30d Paid). Fast-path ONLY — durable correctness is the UNIQUE index.

Workflow steps: status-processing -> extract-text (R2 read, toMarkdown or text(), stage body to R2, return {stagingKey,byteLength}) -> mark-failed-empty if empty -> persist-body (read body back from R2, compute fp, dup-check, write fingerprint/markdownPreview(slice 0,2000)/bodyR2Key) -> chunk-text (read body back, paragraph or sliding, stage {id->content} to R2, return lean records) -> store-chunks-batch (batch 10, read content back from R2, insertMany with tenant/team/scope/user/visibility, FTS auto via triggers) -> embed-batch (batch 50, read content from D1 by id, embed() chokepoint, null->throw to retry, assert len==1024, vec.upsert with canonical metadata, stampEmbedded) -> KG extract (batch 5/LLM call, read content from D1 by id) -> finalize (status indexed, chunkCount, ingestedAt, ingest_log indexed).

1 MiB step-output workaround: never return markdown or chunk content blobs from step.do(); stage to R2, return only keys + lean metadata (ids/indices/heading paths/token counts); downstream steps read back from R2 or D1 by id.

Oversized-upload split: if would exceed MAX_CHUNKS_PER_DOC=4000 OR MAX_BODY_BYTES=8MiB per part, split deterministically at chunk boundaries (never mid-chunk) into multiple documents rows sharing parent_document_id + part_index, each its own Workflow with id ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}#part${k}; citations resolve to (parent_document_id, part_index).

Chunking route: paragraph-packing (gbrain chunkText, TARGET~1200, no overlap, splits only >2x target) for md/text/sessions; sliding-window sentence-aware (cf-graph, maxTokens=512/overlap=64, breaks at '. ' past halfway) for PDF/DOCX/long HTML.

KG extraction: llama-3.1-8b-instruct with canonical-name/typed-kind/confidence prompt + extractJsonFromText salvage (direct parse -> outer-brace slice -> backtrack to last complete } + auto-close) + response_format json_object; dedup LOWER(name) within run + ON CONFLICT; unparseable chunk logged+skipped, never aborts doc; v1 also embeds entities -> brain-entities.

ChatGPT importer: parse conversations.json mapping-tree, pick active leaf (current_node or deepest), walk parent pointers to root for linear order; each text node -> session_turns row; conversation -> sessions row (client='chatgpt'). Drop foreign embeddings, emit 'pending'/dims 0. Per-field unknown-narrowing guards skip mistyped records.

Claude-Code importer: parse JSONL line-by-line (parentUuid backstop), keep user/assistant records with non-empty text (string or concat type:'text' blocks; tool_use/tool_result summarized inline, verbatim in R2); each -> session_turns row; file -> sessions row (client='claude-code'). Cursor = byte/line offset (resumable mid-file).

Resumable cursor/anchor discipline: cursor (in-flight) in run row; durable anchor (last_commit/last_sync_at) advances ONLY on clean full pass; per-file failure -> cursor.failed (retry next tick), never advances anchor; truncated tree refuses new anchor; MAX_FILES_PER_TICK=150.

Eventual consistency: never read back a vector to confirm; D1 is existence authority; vector id==chunk.id so retried upsert converges; deletes idempotent, read path D1 re-check drops stale-but-not-deleted vectors.
invariants: Multi-tenant isolation: tenant_id threads through every row, every Vectorize namespace, every R2 key. ScopedDB injects AND tenant_id=?; ScopedVectorize hard-wires namespace=tenantId; ScopedR2 prefixes keys with tenantId. These are the hard boundary.

FTS isolation: chunks_fts carries NO tenant_id; every MATCH result MUST be JOINed back to chunks via ScopedDB and re-checked on tenant_id/scope before any row leaves the keyword arm. A MATCH-then-unscoped-read is a forbidden leak path (dedicated CI test). Tested blocking in CI (verification #4).
1 MiB non-stream step.do() output cap is hard: never return extracted markdown or chunk content blobs from a step; stage to R2 and return only keys + lean metadata.
D1 100 bound-parameter cap: CHUNK_DB_BATCH_SIZE=10 (lean row ~8 params). Do not tune away.
EMBED_BATCH_SIZE=50 (Workers AI bge-m3 per-call cap ~100, 50 bounds payload/latency). KG_BATCH_SIZE=5 (one LLM call per 5 chunks).

Embedding dimension: assert all vectors length==1024; foreign embeddings (e.g. OB1 1536-d OpenAI) are DROPPED entirely — no copy, no projection; emit embeddingModel='pending', embeddingDims=0; re-embed at bge-m3 1024d. Same dimension is NOT interchangeability; cross-model cosine is meaningless.

trust_grade is deliberately NOT a chunks column and NOT a Vectorize metadata index — it lives only in the memory_use_policy sidecar, LEFT-JOINed at read, so a promotion never re-upserts a vector / rewrites a chunk.
Bodies live in R2 only — D1 stores markdown_preview (<=2000 chars) + body_r2_key, never full markdown/transcript (10 GB single-D1 budget correctness requirement).
Write-path embed failure throws (Workflow retries) — never silently index un-embedded chunks. Read path degrades to keyword-only; the asymmetry is intentional.
Durable dedup correctness rests on (tenant_id, scope, fingerprint) UNIQUE index + skip-unchanged gate, NOT the Workflow instance id (which is only a fast-path within retention window).
Vector id == chunk.id (stable nanoid): re-embed targets the same vector id, no orphan churn; retried upsert converges, never duplicates.
FTS5 synced ONLY by triggers (chunks_ai/ad/au) — no manual chunks_fts inserts.
Importer contract invariants enforced by runImporterContract: (1) terminal cursor is null; (2) empty batch with non-null cursor is a violation (would loop forever).
Backfill anchor advances ONLY on clean full pass; per-file failure never advances anchor (no silent page loss); truncated GitHub tree refuses new anchor.

Vectorize metadata indexes (scope, team_id, visibility, embedding_model) MUST be created before any filtered upsert (Phase 0); indexed values <=64 bytes else not filterable (D1 re-check remains authority).
Splits happen on chunk boundaries, never mid-chunk; per-part ceilings MAX_CHUNKS_PER_DOC=4000 and MAX_BODY_BYTES=8MiB make step budget + byte footprint independent of upload size.

section: 5. Embedding, Hybrid Search, Rerank & Cited Synthesis
summary: Defines the tenant-scoped retrieval pipeline: an embedding chokepoint (bge-m3, 1024d), a hybrid FTS5(bm25) + Vectorize(cosine) fan-out fused with RRF, a NET-NEW cross-encoder rerank stage, and a NET-NEW token-budget-guarded cited synthesis (`think`). Every stage is tenant-scoped by construction and degrades-never-throws per the gbrain degradation contract. The skeleton is lifted from gbrain (search.ts/ops/search.ts/ai.ts), FTS hardening from cf-graph, isolation discipline from openbrains; the two genuinely new pieces are §5.4 rerank and §5.5 synthesis budget guard. Three ops expose pipeline slices: `search` (cheap, no expand/rerank), `query` (expand+rerank), `think` (expand+rerank+synthesis). Cost/rate-limit enforcement is plumbed at the embed/gen/rerank chokepoints, not at call sites.

Hybrid pipeline: embed(query) [+optional expandQuery 2-3 phrasings] → per phrasing parallel FTS arm ∥ vector arm → rrfFusion(K=60, normalize-by-max) per phrasing → rrfFusion across phrasings → trust-grade boost map + applyTitleBoost → top-40 → rerank → top-k(8-12) → think synthesis → write recall trace per kept hit.

FTS arm: sanitizeFtsQuery → split terms; try ' AND ' joiner then ' OR ' fallback (websearch parity); MATCH pure text; WHERE c.tenant_id=? AND c.deleted_at IS NULL [AND c.scope IN(...)]; FTS5 syntax error → [].

Vector arm: embed query (null→[]); foldPartitionFilter folds restricted scopes into {scope:{$in}}; sv.query topK=100 namespace=tenant; filter m.score>=threshold(0.5) on RAW cosine PRE-fusion; getChunksByIds re-JOIN dropping cross-tenant/deleted/out-of-scope/out-of-visibility silently; sort by score desc.

rrfFusion: sum 1/(K+rank) across lists, normalize-by-max, THEN boosts (do not double-normalize with cf-graph variant). boostFactor = TRUST_BOOST{instruction:2.0,evidence:1.0,draft:0.6}. applyTitleBoost 1.25x (contiguous-token-run, ≥2 content-token floor). rrfKey=`${source_id}:${slug}:${chunk_id}`; OR the stale flag across arms.

rerank: contexts=candidates.map(text) in candidate order; AI.run(bge-reranker-base,{query,contexts,top_k}); parse response[] DEFENSIVELY, filter Number.isInteger(id) && 0<=id<len; remap by index to candidate; slice top_k; any error/malformed → RRF order. Candidate set bounded by CUMULATIVE token estimate (default ceiling 40, fewer for large chunks); per-candidate oversized chunk truncated for rerank call only (full text kept for synthesis).

buildSynthesisPrompt: budget = 24000 - 1500(answer) - 800(system+question) - est(question); pack highest-rerank-score-first; single oversized top hit → summarizeForFit map step; budget hit → evict rest, push warnings 'evidence_evicted:N' + gap; est(s)=ceil(len/4) biased optimistic (reserves absorb undercount).

Chokepoint cost/rate guard: embed/gen/rerank pre-check tenant token_spend vs MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD (default 400) and return 429+Retry-After BEFORE env.AI.run if projected monthly spend exceeds. On Workers-AI 429/Capacity error: read-path embed/rerank degrades like missing binding; write-path embed re-queues (Workflow retry); never 429 the end user.
invariants: FTS isolation (P0): tenant predicate (and restricted-principal c.scope IN(...) gate) lives on chunks BASE TABLE after the JOIN; MATCH stays pure text. Copying cf-graph's `MATCH ... AND workspace_id=?` against an external-content table (no such column) is a leak — FORBIDDEN, CI-tested (Plan §5g/§5i, canary #7).
ScopedVectorize hard-wires namespace:tenantId on every query — physically impossible to omit. team_id/scope/embedding_model are only metadata filters WITHIN the namespace.
D1 is the existence/correctness authority: vector-arm D1 re-JOIN re-checks tenant/scope/deleted_at and silently DROPS cross-tenant/deleted/out-of-grant ids — no existence leak (drop, never error).
Vectorize metadata pre-filter is best-effort, NEVER the security boundary (a value >64 B is stored but not indexable); D1 re-check (getChunksByIds + readFacts) remains authoritative on top of it.

visibility (world/team/private) is enforced ONLY at D1 via visibilityPredicate, deliberately NOT pushed into the Vectorize filter — pushing it would exclude the principal's own private chunks (ids the D1 re-check could never recover).
scope $in pre-filter IS pushed into Vectorize for restricted principals — required-before-GA for any agency (Persona C) tenant; scope metadata index must be live before such a tenant onboards.
embed()/gen()/rerank() NEVER throw — return null/RRF-order/[] and degrade to keyword-only or RRF order (gbrain degradation contract, search.ts header lines 7-9 = law for whole pipeline).
Locked model constants: bge-m3 @1024d cosine. Post-call dimension assertion: a model swap that silently changes dims is a P0 — refuse (return null) rather than poison the index.
Threshold on RAW cosine (0.5 recall / 0.85 related) applied PRE-fusion on the vector arm — never on normalized RRF scores (RRF discards cosine for rank).
RRF normalize-by-max once (gbrain), do NOT blend with cf-graph's raw 1/(k+rank+1) or you double-normalize.
trust_grade NOT denormalized onto chunks (LEFT JOIN from memory_use_policy) so a trust promotion never requires a chunk rewrite.
slug/title/source_id NOT on chunks — supplied by documents JOIN (citation fields); chunk_id without hydration cannot cite.
Token-budget guard: overflow is SURFACED in warnings/gaps, never silently truncated mid-document; single oversized hit is summarized (map step), never raw-truncated.
Evidence-only synthesis: empty evidence returns warnings:['no_evidence'] + explicit gap, NEVER a hallucinated answer; LLM unavailable returns retrieved evidence without synthesis.
Audit: every kept think/query hit writes one tenant-scoped memory_recall_traces row; zero hits write zero traces.
Stale hits are surfaced via the stale flag, NOT filtered out — caller decides; re-embed sweep repairs out-of-band.
All env.AI.run route through AI Gateway with tenant_id custom metadata.
Stable nanoid chunk ids (not gbrain's delete+recreate unstable ids); re-ingest uses deterministic ids so a racing upsert converges.

summary: Defines the graph layer of the Brain Platform: a TWO-graph model (document/page link graph over `pages`/`doc_links`, and an extracted knowledge graph over `entities`/`entity_relations`) joined only by an `entity_mentions` bridge — explicitly rejecting a single polymorphic nodes/edges table. The one generalization made is an edge-table-agnostic BFS parameterized by an `EdgeSpec` so a single traversal engine walks both graphs. A durable Cloudflare Workflow (adapted from cf-graph's EntityExtractionWorkflow) extracts entities/relations per document via llama-3.1-8b, upserts into openbrains-shaped D1 tables, embeds entities into a Vectorize index, with deterministic-key dedup and re-extract cleanup. Every read surface enforces multi-tenant isolation (tenant_id) PLUS an intra-tenant access gate (scopePredicate + visibilityPredicate) on node rows, drop-don't-error. Semantic entity dedup is the only deferred piece (Phase 3.5); entity vectors and search_entities are in v1.

algorithms: Generalized BFS traverse(db, spec, startId, depth, direction): clamp depth Math.max(1,Math.min(depth,10)); gate the SEED via db.nodeVisible(spec,startId) -> empty if not visible (no BFS); visited Set seeded with startId; per-layer frontier IN(...) expansion; direction picks fromCol/toCol clauses; SQL JOINs nodeTable nf/nt on edge endpoints, WHERE tenant_id=? AND (clauses) AND soft-delete-null AND nodeGate(nf) AND nodeGate(nt); only emit edge reaching an unvisited node (gbrain CTE parity, avoids re-emitting arrival edge on 'both' walk).

EdgeSpec parameterization: nodeTable/edgeTable/fromCol/toCol/labelCol/typeCol/softDeleteCol + gate cols scopeCol/visibilityCol/teamCol/userCol. DOC_GRAPH has userCol='user_id' (private tier reachable) + softDeleteCol='deleted_at'; ENTITY_GRAPH omits userCol (no private tier) and has no softDeleteCol.

upsertEntity: read-modify-write (D1 not transactional across awaits). SELECT existing by (tenant_id, COALESCE(scope,'')=COALESCE(?,''), kind, lower(canonical_name)); if none INSERT; else union aliases (dedupeCapped 50), union source_chunk_ids, mention_count += chunkIds.length, mergeVisibility max-permissive.
mergeVisibility: world wins; both team & same team_id keeps team; cross-team promotes to world with team_id=NULL. Monotonic: entity only ever becomes more visible.
relate: read-modify-write on (tenant,from,to,kind); insert new, else union evidence_chunk_ids and confidence=max.
mention: INSERT OR IGNORE (idempotent via uniq index).

store-kg: db.batch all upserts/relations/mentions; resolve relation source/target names -> entity ids via lowercased key INCLUDING scope (one scope per batch); skip relation if either endpoint unresolved.

LLM extraction: llama-3.1-8b-instruct with response_format json_object PLUS extractJsonFromText 3-strategy salvage (parse-as-is -> first-brace..last-brace slice -> trim to last complete object). Access tier NOT model-supplied — derived deterministically from source chunks' scope/visibility/team_id.

clear-prior-extraction: delete source's entity_mentions; prune source chunk ids from every entity_relations.evidence_chunk_ids and DELETE relations whose evidence becomes empty; delete orphaned brain-entities vectors by id. Runs first on every extract; idempotent under retry.

find_orphans: doc graph = pages with zero in/out links via NOT EXISTS over doc_links, excluding pseudo-pages (slug starting '_' or containing '/_') unless includePseudo; generalized to entities via NOT EXISTS over entity_relations. Runs under principal's scope/visibility gate.

search_entities: ScopedVectorize(namespace=tenantId) embed(query) -> vector search with scope/visibility in metadata filter -> optional RRF fusion with entity_fts -> authoritative D1 re-check on entities (scopePredicate + {world,team} visibilityPredicate, drop-don't-error).
D1 100-param guard: if frontier > ~90 ids, chunk IN(...) into per-layer sub-queries.
invariants: TWO graphs, one bridge — NEVER a single polymorphic nodes/edges table. Two distinct node types in two distinct edge tables, joined only via entity_mentions.

DOC_GRAPH node space is `pages` ONLY: doc_links.from_id/to_id are ALWAYS pages.id, never documents.id; documents/chunks are content hanging off a page, not graph nodes. A document participates only via its backing page.

Every row carries tenant_id NOT NULL. tenant_id is injected by ScopedDB and ANDed into EVERY frontier hop — the easiest predicate to forget. Cross-tenant hop is impossible: frontier holds tenant-scoped ids, node JOIN rows are tenant-scoped.

Intra-tenant access gate is a ScopedDB CONTRACT on every pages/entities read, NOT a per-op rule: traverse_graph, get_links, get_backlinks, list_entities, get_entity, entity_relations, find_orphans all carry scopePredicate + visibilityPredicate automatically.
Drop-don't-error: an out-of-grant/out-of-visibility seed/slug/anchor yields an EMPTY result, never a 403 and never an existence-leaking error.
Both edge endpoints (nf AND nt) are gated on every hop, so a walk dead-ends at the first unreadable node rather than crossing it.

ENTITY_GRAPH carries NO per-entity 'private' tier — visibility CHECK IN ('team','world') only; load-chunks DROPS visibility='private' chunks before extraction. Private knowledge lives only in the facts store. visibility CHECK column deliberately excludes 'private'.

Visibility merges max-permissive (world wins, cross-team promotes to world); scope is PARTITIONED (part of the dedup key, COALESCE(scope,'')) — 'Acme' under client-A and client-B are TWO entity rows, never merged. A relation never bridges two scopes.
Access tier is derived deterministically from trusted source chunks, NEVER from untrusted LLM output.
Entity dedup key is (tenant_id, COALESCE(scope,''), kind, lower(canonical_name)) — case-insensitive on lowercased form, canonical_name stored as-displayed.
Each step.do returns COUNTS only ({entitiesCreated,entitiesUpdated,relationsCreated}), never entity payloads — stays under 1 MiB step-output cap.
KG extraction is NON-FATAL: on failure the doc is marked 'indexed' with kg_error stamped and stays searchable.
find_orphans is a REPORT, not a deleter; actual deletion is soft-delete on pages, never an automatic graph sweep.
Soft-deleted page endpoints (deleted_at NOT NULL) are filtered from BFS and getLinks — a deleted node's edges vanish without cascade.
MCP add_link refuses to manually write a managed link_source (MANAGED_LINK_SOURCES) so re-ingestion delete-and-recreate of auto links never clobbers hand-authored ones.
revert_version snapshots current state into page_versions BEFORE restoring (db.batch insert-snapshot + update-page) so revert is itself reversible.

section: 7. Multi-Tenant Company Brain: Auth, Scoping, Trust & Audit
summary: This is the security spine: an org→team→user→scope identity model, a `resolvePrincipal()` resolver chain (Clerk JWT → bdev_ HMAC machine token → bk_ API key) that reduces any credential to one immutable `Principal` at the Worker edge, and a single choke-point (`ScopedDB`/`ScopedVectorize`/`ScopedR2`) that injects tenant/scope/visibility predicates so cross-tenant and cross-scope access is impossible by construction. Vectorize uses `namespace=tenantId` (hard-wired, un-omittable) with a mandatory D1 row re-check (drop-don't-error) as the correctness gate; D1 has no native RLS so application-level RLS is enforced in `packages/db`, the only module allowed to touch raw bindings (guarded by a custom ESLint banned-import rule). A trust-grade governance model (`instruction`/`evidence`/`draft`, hard-wired to `evidence` on agent writeback, human-promoted only) is orthogonal to visibility (`private`/`team`/`world`). Append-only `memory_audit` + `memory_recall_traces` are written in the same `db.batch` as the change, with an audited+alerted admin break-glass surface as the sole carve-out. Build order: schema/migrations → Principal+resolver → Scoped* choke-point → OAuth/MCP wiring → governance/audit → canary CI suite.

Injects tenant_id + scopePredicate + visibilityPredicate on every read; typed methods only, NO public raw-SQL passthrough. Graph arm methods getLinks/expandFrontier/nodeGate/nodeVisible/resolveScopedNode.

Mint-time data-partition derivation: allowed_scopes = intersect(requestedGrant, minter.allowedScopes); '*' minter is identity element; restricted minter can only ever store a subset of own grant — widening structurally impossible

namespace=tenantId is hard-wired by createScopedVectorize on every upsert/query — physically impossible to omit (callers never build the raw query). Namespace is NOT claimed as a security boundary; the guarantee rests on hard-wiring + the D1 re-check

D1 row re-check is the correctness gate: every Vectorize/FTS hit re-JOINed to live D1 and re-checked on tenant_id/scope/deleted_at; cross-tenant ids SILENTLY DROPPED — drop-don't-error, no existence leak (openbrains recall.ts rule)
Raw bindings (env.DB, raw Vectorize index, raw R2) importable ONLY inside packages/db; enforced by custom ESLint banned-import rule as a blocking CI control
ScopedDB exposes NO public raw-SQL passthrough (no .all(sql,binds) escape hatch) — graph reads are typed methods, so no read arm can bind only tenant_id and skip scope/visibility gates

Two separate axes, never conflated: allowedScopes (DATA partition: client/project slugs or '*') vs capabilities (read|write|admin). Separate fields, separately sourced, separately consumed (iter-2 fix — single 'scopes' field was the bug)
No bare token travels below the edge — resolvePrincipal runs once at edge; every service/Workflow step/Queue handler receives a Principal

Mint-time: key allowed_scopes = intersect(requestedGrant, minter.allowedScopes); NULL(='*') stored ONLY iff minter was '*'; restricted minter can NEVER widen its own data partition — one-step escalation structurally impossible

visibilityPredicate is un-omittable at the choke-point on EVERY default read of a row carrying a visibility column (facts AND chunks): world OR (team AND team_id IN teamIds) OR (private AND user_id=p.userId)

owner/admin do NOT bypass visibilityPredicate on default recall/think/graph/get_session_context paths; the ONLY exception is break-glass with all four gates: (a) requireRole(admin), (b) explicit signal fail-closed (non-admin→403), (c) every read writes breakglass_read audit row + fires alert, (d) tenant_id never bypassed (intra-tenant only)
world visibility is tenant-global, NEVER cross-tenant; visibility filters within a tenant, never widens the tenant boundary
trust_grade hard-wired to 'evidence' on agent writeback — NO trustGrade argument exists on the input; promotion to 'instruction' flows exclusively through human-confirmed memory_review (owner/admin)
On write: user_id is FORCED to p.userId (never body-controlled); scope must pass assertScopeAllowed; team_id must be in p.teamIds; world write requires admin/owner

memory_audit is append-only (no UPDATE/DELETE in app code) and written in the SAME db.batch as the change it describes — atomicity = one batch (D1 has no interactive transactions); R2 export is the tamper-evidence backstop (SC7)
memory_recall_traces: dropped (cross-tenant) ids never produce a trace — only kept hits do (insert inside the keep branch); trace read author-only

dataModel.name: sessions
dataModel.notes: NET-NEW first-class session store. PK id (nanoid). tenant_id NOT NULL, team_id, user_id NOT NULL (authorship), scope, client CHECK(claude-code|claude-desktop|chatgpt|cli|web|import), source_session_id (client's own id for idempotent upsert), started_at, ended_at (set ONLY on explicit close; may stay NULL on missed Stop-hook), last_activity_at NOT NULL DEFAULT now() (refreshed on EVERY capture_turn; idle-sweep key), status CHECK(open|finalizing|promoted|failed) DEFAULT open, turn_count, r2_key=${tenantId}/sessions/${id}.jsonl, content_hash=sha256(normalizeForFingerprint(transcript)), metadata JSON. Indexes: idx_sessions_user(tenant_id,user_id,started_at DESC); idx_sessions_client(tenant_id,client,started_at DESC); idx_sessions_open(tenant_id,status,last_activity_at) keyed on last_activity_at NOT ended_at; UNIQUE idx_sessions_source(tenant_id,client,source_session_id) WHERE source_session_id IS NOT NULL.

dataModel.name: session_turns
dataModel.notes: Lean index, long bodies offloaded to R2. PK id, tenant_id NOT NULL, session_id REFERENCES sessions(id), idx INTEGER (ordinal), role CHECK(user|assistant|system|tool), content (short inline; NULL when offloaded), r2_offset="${r2_key}#L<start>-L<end>" when offloaded, token_count, created_at. UNIQUE idx_session_turns_order(tenant_id,session_id,idx). Offload when length(content)>TURN_INLINE_MAX (default 2 KB); full transcript always in R2.

dataModel.name: facts
dataModel.notes: Hot memory; gbrain 0004_facts.sql ported verbatim + tenancy/governance. PK id AUTOINCREMENT, tenant_id NOT NULL (replaces gbrain source_id='default'), scope, team_id, user_id, entity_slug, fact NOT NULL, kind CHECK(event|preference|commitment|belief|fact) DEFAULT fact, visibility CHECK(private|team|world) DEFAULT private (ACCESS control), notability CHECK(high|medium|low) DEFAULT medium, context, valid_from DEFAULT now(), valid_until, expired_at, superseded_by REFERENCES facts(id), consolidated_at, consolidated_into, source NOT NULL (e.g. session:promote, mcp:extract_facts), source_session_id (renamed from gbrain source_session), confidence REAL DEFAULT 1.0 CHECK(0..1), is_dream_generated INTEGER DEFAULT 0 (anti-loop guard), created_at. Partial indexes (active=expired_at IS NULL) re-keyed on tenant_id: idx_facts_entity_active, idx_facts_session, idx_facts_since. trust_grade lives separately in memory_use_policy sidecar (section 3), NOT a column here.

dataModel.name: facts_fts
dataModel.notes: FTS5 external-content virtual table (gbrain 0004_facts.sql:62-84 verbatim): facts_fts USING fts5(fact, entity_slug, content='facts', content_rowid='id') + insert/delete/update triggers identical to gbrain 69-84. CANNOT carry tenant_id in MATCH; recall JOINs rowid back to tenant-scoped facts base via ScopedDB and re-checks tenant_id/scope/expired_at before any row leaves the keyword arm.

dataModel.name: brain_snapshots
dataModel.notes: Frozen-snapshot storage (DEFERRED phase); ports gbrain page_versions shape. PK id, tenant_id NOT NULL, scope, label NOT NULL, created_by NOT NULL (user_id), created_at, manifest TEXT NOT NULL (JSON pinning immutable version ids: fact ids at valid_from, page_versions ids, chunk ids). idx_snapshots_tenant(tenant_id,created_at DESC).

dataModel.name: backfill_runs
dataModel.notes: Fuses gbrain jobs + openbrains imports; owns enumerator-run state (cursor/anchor/stats) + optimistic claim. PK id, tenant_id NOT NULL, source_id NOT NULL, kind (session|repo|doc|gmail|ob1|reembed), direction CHECK(backfill|incremental) DEFAULT backfill, status CHECK(queued|running|success|failure|cancelled) DEFAULT queued, cursor (importer opaque resume point), anchor (durable; advances only on clean pass), stats JSON {processed,created,skipped,errors,merged}, attempts, fail_count, note, error, created_at, updated_at. idx_backfill_status(tenant_id,source_id,status). Optimistic claim: UPDATE ... SET status='running' WHERE id=? AND status=? AND updated_at=? + STALE_RUNNING_MS reclaim.

dataModel.name: chunks (+ chunks_fts)
dataModel.notes: Session/long-term chunks join the shared brain-chunks index. Each chunk row carries the SESSION's visibility/user_id/team_id (iter-3) so a private session's chunks are private on hybrid/think arm. Has embedded_at/embedding_model staleness columns (gbrain 0002_search.sql) for re-embed drift detection. chunks_fts triggers fired on store; CHUNK_DB_BATCH_SIZE=10 (D1 100-param limit).

dataModel.name: memory_audit / memory_provenance / memory_use_policy / memory_recall_traces
dataModel.notes: Governance sidecars (section 3) written in same db.batch as facts. memory_use_policy holds trust_grade (instruction|evidence|draft); promote hard-wires trust_grade='evidence'. memory_provenance gets origin (agent_inferred for promote, import for backfill) + session_id. memory_audit gets action (e.g. fact.promote) + user_id + target_id. memory_recall_traces row per kept hit: (tenant_id,user_id,query,target_id,score,client_id,at), written off the sync read path via ctx.waitUntil batched to a separate trace store.

dataModel.name: session transcripts
dataModel.notes: Full transcript JSONL addressed by r2_key=${tenantId}/sessions/${id}.jsonl. Always present regardless of inline turns. Body-offload discipline: D1 holds index+lean rows, R2 holds full bodies (correctness requirement for single shared D1 under 10 GB).

dataModel.name: backfill payload bodies
dataModel.notes: Large importer items written to R2 first via scopedR2.putIfLarge(item) returning inline string OR r2 key; only the reference is enqueued.

dataModel.name: brain-chunks index
dataModel.notes: V2; namespace=tenantId; 1024d bge-m3 vectors. Metadata {userId,teamId,scope,sessionId,visibility,embedding_model:'bge-m3'}; visibility carried for best-effort metadata pre-filter only (authoritative gate is D1 readFacts/visibilityPredicate). Vectorize eventual consistency: D1 row is the existence gate; vector deletes idempotent/retry-safe.

dataModel.name: brain-backfill (+ brain-backfill-dlq)
dataModel.notes: Message {tenantId,sourceId,runId,kind,payloadRef,fingerprint}. Consumer config: max_batch_size:10, max_batch_timeout:30, max_retries:5, dead_letter_queue:'brain-backfill-dlq', max_concurrency:10, retry_delay:30. Per-message ack/retry({delaySeconds}); poison -> DLQ.

dataModel.name: brain-reembed
dataModel.notes: Cron-fed; carries stale/missing-embedding rows for re-embedding at 1024d. Drain gated by EMBED_BATCH_SIZE=50 + Queue concurrency; traffic tagged 'migration' in AI Gateway.

algorithms: capture_turn flow: upsert sessions by (tenant_id,client,source_session_id=session_id); append session_turns at idx=turn_count; bump turn_count; refresh last_activity_at=now() on the SAME write; append turn to R2 transcript; all D1 writes in one db.batch (no cross-await tx in D1).

SessionPromoteWorkflow steps: load-transcript (ScopedR2.get) -> extract-facts (gbrain extractFactsFromText, retries 3 exp) -> writeback-facts (atomic db.batch) -> chunk (paragraph-packing CHUNK_TARGET~1200) -> embed-batch-N (EMBED_BATCH_SIZE=50, bge-m3 1024d, ScopedVectorize upsert, retries 5 exp) -> store-chunks-batch-N (CHUNK_DB_BATCH_SIZE=10 + chunks_fts triggers; chunk rows carry session visibility/user_id/team_id) -> finalize (status='promoted').

Re-finalize clean replace (idempotent): in writeback-facts first soft-expire prior promoted set UPDATE facts SET expired_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=? AND source_session_id=? AND expired_at IS NULL (preserves lineage, not hard-delete); dedupe extracted set in-batch on (tenant_id, entity_slug, kind, LOWER(TRIM(fact))); then insert. Deterministic embedding-free rule, NOT cosine/classifier dedup.

Writeback batch per fact: insertFact (trust_grade hard-wired via sidecar) + insertUsePolicy{trust_grade:'evidence'} + insertProvenance{origin:'agent_inferred',session_id} + insertAudit{action:'fact.promote'} in one db.batch.

Idle-promotion sweep SQL: SELECT id,tenant_id,scope,team_id,user_id FROM sessions WHERE status='open' AND last_activity_at < datetime('now','-'||:idle_minutes||' minutes') LIMIT :batch; create SessionPromoteWorkflow per row (deterministic id makes racing manual finalize a no-op).

recall: dispatch by entity/since/session/keyword/grep; parseSinceParam ('8 hours ago','30m',ISO) ported verbatim; base WHERE always carries tenant_id + scope + visibilityPredicate via ScopedDB.readFacts; FTS keyword arm id IN (SELECT rowid FROM facts_fts WHERE facts_fts MATCH ?) JOINed back to tenant-scoped base; cross-tenant or visibility-failing target_id silently dropped, no trace; per-hit trace write off sync path via ctx.waitUntil.
visibilityPredicate: (visibility='world' OR (visibility='team' AND team_id IN p.teamIds) OR (visibility='private' AND user_id = p.userId)) — always ANDed in readFacts.

EnumeratorWorkflow loop: begin(resumeCursor) -> while cursor!=null: step.do(page-n) { nextBatch(cursor); for each item scopedR2.putIfLarge -> enqueue reference {tenantId,sourceId,runId,kind,payloadRef,fingerprint}; return nextCursor }; persistCursor+stats after every batch (advance only on clean batch); finalize() (anchor advances clean pass only). Bounds items per run (MAX_FILES_PER_TICK=150) and re-creates self with saved cursor for huge sources.

Importer contract invariants (runImporterContract): no empty-batch-with-non-null-cursor; terminal null cursor; finalize once. Cursor/anchor discipline: per-item failure never advances anchor; truncated source tree refuses to recompute anchor.

brain-backfill consumer: per-message msg.ack()/msg.retry({delaySeconds}) so one poison item doesn't fail batch; build Principal from explicit message tenant_id; heavy items spawn Batch-Ingest Workflow id ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint}.

Re-embed sweep: cron selects rows where embedding_model!='bge-m3' OR embedded_at IS NULL OR updated_at>embedded_at -> enqueue brain-reembed; consumer re-embeds, upserts same Vectorize id, stamps embedded_at/embedding_model. Budgeted resumable migration: cost ~ N*T x bge-m3 $/Mtok recorded in migration backfill_run before kickoff.

Frozen-snapshot injection: manifest pins immutable version ids; get_session_context resolves pinned versions (never live rows) for snapshot_id; no snapshot_id returns live state read through ScopedDB.readFacts so visibility predicate + trust_grade='instruction' filter apply.
invariants: tenant_id is threaded through EVERY row, Vectorize namespace, R2 key, Queue message, and Workflow param; isolation enforced structurally via ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2 (section 5), NEVER by hand-written WHERE clauses.
Body-offload rule (correctness, not optimization): D1 holds index + lean rows only; full transcripts always live in R2 addressed by r2_key — required for the single shared D1 under 10 GB.

last_activity_at (NOT ended_at) is the idle-sweep key; idx_sessions_open is keyed on last_activity_at. A missed Stop-hook leaves ended_at NULL forever, so an ended_at-keyed sweep could never recover it (iter-3 SC6 fix). last_activity_at MUST be refreshed on every capture_turn.

ScopedDB.readFacts ALWAYS ANDs visibilityPredicate({visibility,team_id,user_id}); visibility is access control and is never an optional caller-supplied filter (gbrain's optional-narrowing treatment is unsafe here). User B never recalls user A's private fact; team tier enforced (iter-3 CRITICAL intra-tenant RLS fix).

trust_grade and visibility stay orthogonal: visibility=access control (column on facts); trust_grade=agent-behaviour signal in memory_use_policy sidecar. Promoted/backfilled facts are written trust_grade='evidence' and NEVER auto-promoted to 'instruction'.

FTS5 MATCH cannot carry tenant_id: keyword arm must JOIN facts_fts rowid back to tenant-scoped facts base and re-check tenant_id/scope/expired_at (and visibility) before any row leaves; enclosing WHERE always built by ScopedDB so tenant_id=? is present.

POST /ingest: all body-supplied partition fields validated through ScopedDB on write, never trusted from body (iter-3 write-isolation fix). body scope must pass assertScopeAllowed (else 403); body team_id must be in p.teamIds; user_id is FORCED to p.userId (not body-controlled); body visibility constrained by constrainVisibility(requested,p) (world/tenant-global write requires admin/owner).
Deterministic Workflow ids make re-triggers no-ops: promote-${tenantId}-${sessionId} and ingest-${tenantId}-${fingerprint} (idempotent under retries/duplicate Stop-hooks/at-least-once delivery).

Re-finalize must be a clean replace not an append: soft-expire prior promoted set for source_session_id (preserving lineage) before inserting fresh facts; dedupe in-batch on (tenant_id,entity_slug,kind,LOWER(TRIM(fact))).
Anti-loop: is_dream_generated session/turn skips fact extraction so promoted facts never re-feed extraction.
D1 has no interactive transactions across awaits: every multi-write op uses a single db.batch; CHUNK_DB_BATCH_SIZE=10 respects the D1 100-param limit; writeback uses one db.batch per fact.
Anchor advances ONLY on a clean full pass; per-item failure never advances the anchor (no silent page loss); truncated source tree refuses to recompute the anchor.
Enumerator enqueues REFERENCES only, never inline payloads/embeddings — stays under 10k-step and 1 MiB step-output Workflow caps; large bodies go to R2 first.
Importers drop any foreign embeddings and emit embeddingModel:'pending'/embeddingDims:0 so the re-embed worker re-embeds at 1024d; per-field guards skip-record on schema drift, never throw.
embed()/generate() return null/degrade and never throw (gbrain ai.ts contract); on AI-binding-absent, extract reports extraction_failed and chunk stays embedded_at IS NULL for re-embed retry.
Cross-tenant id in recall results is silently dropped — no trace, no existence leak.
Vectorize eventual consistency: D1 row is the authoritative existence gate; vector deletes are idempotent/retry-safe and never assumed immediately visible.
Chunk rows carry the SESSION's visibility/user_id/team_id so a private session's chunks remain private on the hybrid/think arm too.
Recall trace writes are off the synchronous read path (ctx.waitUntil, batched to a separate trace store) so a read never blocks on single-writer D1.
Queue consumer builds Principal from the explicit message tenant_id and goes through Scoped* (bindings remove network surface but never bypass isolation).

summary: Defines four client-facing surfaces (HTTP/tRPC API, unified MCP server, `brain` CLI, TanStack Start dashboard) over a single multi-tenant isolation invariant: every request resolves a `Principal` at the edge and touches tenant data only through `ScopedDB`/`ScopedVectorize`/`ScopedR2`; surfaces are thin adapters that never re-implement scoping. All four live in a monorepo (`apps/api`, `apps/cli`, `apps/dashboard`) sharing `packages/shared` (Zod schemas, types, model constants) as one source of truth. A single Zod-based operation registry (modeled on gbrain ops, upgraded from ParamDef to Zod) generates the MCP tool catalog, tRPC procedures, and CLI commands so they cannot drift. The MCP server is a per-tenant Durable Object that is only the protocol instance, never the system of record. Everything is built incrementally Phases 1-4 (registry grows per capability) and wired into transports + UI in Phase 5.

algorithms: resolvePrincipal(req,env): try in order (1) OAuth/Clerk JWT (jose.jwtVerify vs remote JWKS, issuer-checked, sub->userId); active tenant resolved FIRST by one pinned mechanism per surface (signed /mcp/<slug>, validated X-Brain-Tenant header, or server session pin) — never from JWT alone; unspecified => 401 (never silent first-membership default); then scoped membership lookup WHERE user_id=? AND tenant_id=? (no row => 401). (2) Machine token bdev_<payload>.<sig> HMAC-SHA256 verified via WebCrypto, tenant_id baked in, allowedScopes from membership lookup. (3) API key bk_ + SHA-256 hash lookup in api_keys.hash; capabilities from scopes[], allowedScopes from stored allowed_scopes. Failure => 401. Only the Principal reaches handlers; a bare token never reaches the service layer.

scopeSatisfied(required, principal): gbrain hierarchy verbatim, evaluated against principal.capabilities (NOT allowedScopes): admin implies all, write implies read; readOnly principal denied any write/admin. Mutating ops also check principal.readOnly before dispatch (belt-and-suspenders).
Capability registration: read-only principals get only the read subset of ops registered (cf-graph pattern); double-gated by scopeSatisfied.

tRPC ctx build: createContext(env, principal, ec) constructs ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2 + AiServices; documents router ported verbatim but swaps explicit workspaceId inputs for implicit ctx.principal.tenantId (removes 'forgot a filter' leak class); waitUntil(result.backgroundWork) kicks Workflow after response.
/ingest handler: body-hash, content-type normalize to md/plain/json, 256KB cap, ingest_log audit row, enqueue Queue message (not D1 jobs row) carrying tenant_id, return 202.

traverse_graph BFS: generalized over doc_links AND entity_relations, depth 1..10; every frontier query through ScopedDB appends AND tenant_id=? to the IN(...) query; CI test asserts shared slug cannot walk across tenants.

search_entities: ScopedVectorize namespace=tenantId, scope/visibility folded into metadata filter then re-checked on entities D1 row via scopePredicate + {world,team} visibilityPredicate, optionally fused with entity_fts via RRF.

Spend pre-check: app-level token_spend check before env.AI.run; trips 429 + Retry-After when projected monthly spend would exceed MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD (default 400). Request-RATE limit instead degrades read path / re-queues write path.
CLI device-flow auth: OAuth 2.1 device flow (loginWithBrowser); tokens (access+refresh+expiresAt) persisted to ~/.config/brain/config.json; client auto-refreshes on 401.

Dashboard server fn: resolve Principal server-side (Clerk auth() for userId, tenant from active-tenant cookie re-validated against memberships), build scoped service deps from Worker bindings, call typed service, map ServiceInputError->Error; tenant NEVER from request body. Tenant switch re-keys all loaders (TanStack invalidation).
invariants: Every surface resolves a Principal at the edge and touches tenant data ONLY through ScopedDB/ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2; a surface never re-implements scoping.
Two axes kept strictly separate: allowedScopes = DATA partition (client/project scopes), capabilities = CAPABILITY axis (read|write|admin). The earlier single-scopes collapse is removed.

tenantId comes from the authenticated context / pinned mechanism (slug / X-Brain-Tenant header / session pin), NEVER from the JWT alone; when unspecified the resolver errors 401 — never a silent first-membership default.
Membership lookup is scoped to exactly one tenant per request so a multi-tenant user never over-matches; resolved Principal bound to exactly one tenant.
A bare token never reaches the service layer — only the resolved Principal does.
A restricted key never resolves to '*': api_keys.allowed_scopes pinned at mint to the intersection with the minter's grant (NULL=>'*' only when minter was '*') — the §7.2 iter-3 escalation fix.

scopeSatisfied evaluated against capabilities, NOT allowedScopes. readOnly principal denied write/admin; mutating ops also re-check principal.readOnly; read-only principals get only the read subset registered (double gate).
Cross-tenant id requested => NOT_FOUND (never FORBIDDEN) so existence isn't leaked. Unscoped query by restricted-allowedScopes principal silently returns only granted scopes (no leak, no error).
Explicit out-of-grant scope argument => FORBIDDEN (deliberate authorization denial, distinct from silent drop on unscoped reads).
Read-only writes => FORBIDDEN.
memory_writeback hard-wires trust_grade='evidence' (no arg); memory_review is the ONLY path to 'instruction' grade.
memory.break_glass_read: role in {owner,admin} only, fails CLOSED to 403 for non-admins, writes breakglass_read audit row + high-severity alert on every call, intra-tenant only.
Every BFS hop carries tenant_id; traverse_graph cross-tenant hop is structurally impossible (ScopedDB appends AND tenant_id=?); CI test enforces.

Internal hops (Worker<->Workflow, Worker<->Queue-consumer) are native bindings, NOT REST; openbrains X-OpenBrains-Internal-Secret HTTP internal routes are dropped (no Convex => no internal HTTP boundary).
Dashboard tenant taken from server-side membership resolution (active-tenant cookie re-validated each fn call), never from request body; userId attribution from Clerk auth(), not request body.
Eventual consistency: §5c server-side re-check drops vector hits whose D1 row was deleted before they reach the client; UI never renders a cross-tenant or deleted row.
app-level token_spend pre-check is the enforcing monthly cost cap; AI Gateway spend limits do NOT cover the all-@cf/ v1 model set.
One operation registry is the single source of truth; catalog cannot drift between MCP, tRPC, and CLI — adding an Operation surfaces it in all three with no further wiring.
