summary: This section is the operational spine: the authoritative wrangler.jsonc binding manifest, secrets/migrations/cron mechanics, a four-tier observability model, a workerd-based test harness that PROVES multi-tenant isolation, and a phased deploy/rollout runbook. The whole platform deploys as ONE Worker (apps/api) owning the Hono REST router, the BrainMCP Durable Object, all 4 Workflow classes, and all Queue consumers; environments (dev/staging/production) are full independent stacks while tenants are partitioned WITHIN an environment by tenant_id. v1 runs on a SINGLE D1 (sharding deferred to Phase-N) with two Vectorize indexes (brain-chunks, brain-entities, both 1024d bge-m3). The hard correctness story is that tenant/scope/visibility isolation is enforced in code via Scoped* wrappers and proven by a blocking 15-canary isolation suite plus a reranker output-shape gate, all required CI merge checks.

components.name: apps/api
components.purpose: The single deployed Worker (main: apps/api/src/server.ts). Owns Hono REST router, BrainMCP DO, all Workflow classes, all Queue consumers, the scheduled() cron handler. Single entry point.

components.name: apps/dashboard
components.purpose: Optional separate Worker UI; if deployed separately it calls apps/api via a Service Binding (binding API, entrypoint DashboardRpc), not over HTTP-with-secret.

components.name: BrainMCP
components.purpose: MCP server instance only (NOT system of record). SQLite-DO class, registered via migrations[] tag v1 / new_sqlite_classes.

components.name: EnumeratorWorkflow
components.purpose: Source enumeration (binding ENUMERATOR_WORKFLOW, name brain-enumerator). Resumable from backfill_runs.cursor.

components.name: BatchIngestWorkflow
components.purpose: Durable batch ingestion (binding INGEST_WORKFLOW, name brain-batch-ingest).

components.name: EntityExtractionWorkflow
components.purpose: Entity extraction + embed-entities step producing entity vectors (binding ENTITY_WORKFLOW, name brain-entity-extract).

components.name: SessionPromoteWorkflow
components.purpose: Promotes idle/closed sessions to memory (binding PROMOTE_WORKFLOW, name brain-session-promote); triggered by idle-session cron sweep.

components.name: BACKFILL_QUEUE / brain-backfill
components.purpose: Backfill async spine; consumer max_batch_size 10, max_batch_timeout 30, max_retries 5, DLQ brain-backfill-dlq, max_concurrency 10, retry_delay 30.

components.name: REEMBED_QUEUE / brain-reembed
components.purpose: Re-embed migration spine; consumer max_batch_size 10, max_batch_timeout 30, max_retries 5, DLQ brain-reembed-dlq, max_concurrency 5, retry_delay 60.

components.name: DashboardRpc
components.purpose: RPC entrypoint on apps/api exposed to the dashboard Worker via Service Binding; internal handlers still build a Principal from explicit tenant_id and go through Scoped*.

components.name: packages/db
components.purpose: The ONLY place raw env.DB/Vectorize/R2 bindings may be imported (ESLint-enforced). Houses ScopedDB, ScopedVectorize, ScopedR2, ai-gateway.ts wrapper, ops-metrics.ts, embed()/gen()/rerank() chokepoints, migrations/.

components.name: packages/db/migrations
components.purpose: Drizzle-generated D1 schema migrations (migrations_dir), realizing the §3 schema.

dataModel.name: brain-platform (single DB, binding DB)
dataModel.notes: v1 single D1, no shard fan-out. Every isolatable table carries tenant_id NOT NULL. Realizes §3 schema. Sharding deferred: tenant_shards rows all resolve to DB in v1; future DB_SHARD_n bindings appended and tenant_shards.db_binding names which binding ScopedDB resolves per request. Migrations Drizzle SQL under packages/db/migrations, applied via wrangler d1 migrations apply.

dataModel.name: tenant_shards
dataModel.notes: Routing table: db_binding (which D1 binding ScopedDB uses; v1 always 'DB'), chunk_index (which Vectorize index; v1 base). Provisioning a tenant inserts orgs + tenant_shards row.

dataModel.name: mcp_request_log
dataModel.notes: Reused from gbrain logMcpRequest with tenant_id ADDED. Columns: id PK AUTOINCREMENT, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, token_name, operation NOT NULL, latency_ms, status DEFAULT 'ok' (ok|error), error_message (message only, never params/PII), created_at. Indexes: idx_mcp_log_tenant_created(tenant_id,created_at), idx_mcp_log_operation(operation). Written via waitUntil, never-throw.

dataModel.name: memory_audit
dataModel.notes: Governance audit; written IN THE SAME db.batch([...]) as the mutation (atomicity non-negotiable). Has tenant_id. Break-glass reads write exactly one row action='breakglass_read', actor, diff carrying target principal + query/target_id. Bounded by WRITE volume not read volume.

dataModel.name: memory_recall_traces
dataModel.notes: One row per kept recall hit, has tenant_id. Decoupled from synchronous read path: emitted via ctx.waitUntil, batched out-of-band to a separate trace store (dedicated traces D1/shard or Analytics Engine) so reads never block on single-writer trace write.

dataModel.name: ingest_log
dataModel.notes: Tier-3 audit table, tenant_id column.

dataModel.name: token_spend
dataModel.notes: Durable per-tenant spend record; records neurons billed (v1 unit ~$0.011/1000 neurons). App-level token_spend pre-check is THE enforcing cap (429 before env.AI.run) when projected monthly spend > MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD.

dataModel.name: backfill_runs
dataModel.notes: Run state incl. cursor (Enumerator resume point), stats (observability), and the re-embed migration's cost estimate row. status/updated_at used by optimistic conditional claim.

dataModel.name: api_keys
dataModel.notes: API keys minted per tenant, SHA-256-hashed, stored here (NOT secrets-store). Each bound to exactly one tenant_id.

dataModel.name: sessions
dataModel.notes: Has status (open/...), last_activity_at (refreshed on every capture_turn), ended_at (may be NULL on missed Stop-hook). Idle-promotion cron keys on last_activity_at NOT ended_at.

dataModel.name: sources (sync state)
dataModel.notes: last_attempt_at, sync_fail_count drive stale-source re-enqueue with exponential backoff BACKOFF_BASE_MS*2**fail_count capped BACKOFF_MAX_MS (from gbrain 0009_sync.sql).

dataModel.name: FTS5 tables: chunks_fts, entity_fts, facts_fts
dataModel.notes: External-content FTS5, TRIGGER-SYNCED pattern (gbrain 0001_init), NOT manually populated. FTS MATCH must JOIN back through ScopedDB to enforce tenant_id (the §5g leak guard).

dataModel.name: brain-chunks (binding CHUNKS_INDEX)
dataModel.notes: Chunk vectors, dims 1024, metric cosine. Metadata indexes (must exist before first filtered upsert): team_id, scope, visibility, embedding_model (all string). namespace=tenantId enforced in code by ScopedVectorize, NOT a metadata index.

dataModel.name: brain-entities (binding ENTITY_INDEX)
dataModel.notes: Entity vectors from embed-entities Workflow step, dims 1024, metric cosine. Metadata indexes: scope, team_id, visibility, embedding_model (all string). Provisioned in v1; only cross-session semantic dedup over entity vectors deferred to Phase 3.5.

dataModel.name: brain-platform-files (binding FILES)
dataModel.notes: Raw bodies/transcripts. Tenant-prefixed keys ${tenantId}/... enforced by ScopedR2. D1 stores only r2_key + preview, never the body.

dataModel.name: OAUTH_KV
dataModel.notes: workers-oauth-provider OAuth state + per-user default scope KV.

dataModel.name: BrainMCP SQLite storage
dataModel.notes: MCP server instance state only; versioned via wrangler migrations[] (tag v1).

dataModel.name: brain-backfill / brain-reembed (+DLQs)
dataModel.notes: Producer messages carry {tenantId,...}; consumers ack/retry per-message. brain-reembed traffic tagged metadata.surface='migration' so a runaway re-embed can't exhaust a tenant's interactive budget.

cfBindings: ai: AI (Workers AI binding; AI Gateway invoked via gateway option, NOT a binding)
services (dashboard only): API -> brain-platform entrypoint DashboardRpc
vars: EMBEDDING_MODEL, EMBEDDING_DIMS, GENERATION_MODEL, EXTRACTION_MODEL, RERANKER_MODEL, AI_GATEWAY_ID, SYNTHESIS_TOKEN_BUDGET, MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD
Secrets-Store (secrets_store_secrets) — deferred, only for future per-target external HTTP secret
surface: REST: POST /ingest (Hono router on apps/api) — body may carry scope/team_id/user_id/visibility, all gated to principal grant
MCP tools (BrainMCP DO): think, recall, search, traverse_graph, get_links, get_backlinks, get_session_context, capture_turn, writeFact, memory.break_glass_read (admin-only)
CLI: bdev_ machine tokens + bk_ API keys (HMAC-SHA256 signed; canonical platform prefixes)
Internal RPC: DashboardRpc entrypoint via Service Binding (constructs Principal from explicit tenant_id)
wrangler CLI deploy ops: d1 create/migrations apply, vectorize create + create-metadata-index, queues create, kv namespace create, secret put, deploy --env, rollback
scheduled() cron handler: fans out to (1) stale-source re-enqueue, (2) re-embed sweep, (3) idle-session promotion
Analytics Engine SQL API: powers §7-Phase-5 dashboard panels + §0 scale-trigger queries
algorithms: AI Gateway call: env.AI.run(model, inputs, {gateway:{id:AI_GATEWAY_ID, metadata:{tenant_id, surface}, skipCache:false}}); capture env.AI.aiGatewayLogId to correlate to gateway log. surface='migration' for re-embed.

Per-tenant cost enforcement: app-level token_spend pre-check runs BEFORE env.AI.run; returns 429 with Retry-After when projected monthly spend would exceed MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD (default 400, per-tenant-overridable). AI Gateway spend limits are attribution-only for all-@cf/ v1 set.

Workers AI request-RATE limits: clamped at embed/gen/rerank chokepoints + re-embed/backfill pacing against assumed conservative ceilings (embed ~300/min, synthesis ~100/min, rerank ~300/min, unverified-until-staging); a rate hit degrades-or-queues, never 429s the interactive user.

Re-embed migration (qwen3/1536d -> bge-m3 1024d): budgeted, resumable, dry-run-first. Enqueue any row where embedding_model != @cf/baai/bge-m3 OR embedded_at IS NULL OR updated_at > embedded_at onto brain-reembed; estimate cost (N chunks x T tokens x $/Mtok) into backfill_runs BEFORE kickoff; tag surface='migration'. Same-dimension vectors are RE-EMBEDDED never copied.

cron scheduled() fan-out: (1) re-enqueue Enumerator for sources past backoff (exp backoff capped), (2) enqueue stale/pending/wrong-model rows to brain-reembed rate-paced, (3) find sessions status='open' AND last_activity_at < now()-IDLE and trigger SessionPromoteWorkflow.

cron optimistic conditional claim retained for enumerator-run row only: UPDATE ... WHERE status=? AND updated_at=? with meta.changes check + STALE_RUNNING_MS reclaim; Queue owns message-level dispatch.
Analytics Engine writeDataPoint: indexes=[tenantId], blobs=[op,tenantId,status,surface], doubles=[latencyMs,candidateCount,evidenceCount].

ScopedDB injects AND tenant_id = ? on every query; FTS MATCH JOINs back through ScopedDB; ScopedVectorize hard-wires namespace=tenantId; vector results re-JOIN D1 to drop ids whose tenant_id doesn't match (metadata-lag drop); ScopedR2 prefixes ${tenantId}/.

Scope/visibility gates: foldPartitionFilter pushes granted scope into Vectorize metadata filter so topK budget spent inside grant; visibilityPredicate spans facts (ScopedDB.readFacts) and chunks (hydrateChunks/getChunksByIds) for private/team/world tiers; break-glass (breakGlassReadPrivate) gated on org-scoped admin/owner role, fails closed for non-admins, writes audit+alert on success.
Synthesis token-budget guard (§4.3): evicts highest-score-last, never truncates mid-doc, keeps under SYNTHESIS_TOKEN_BUDGET (20000) < 24k window.

Rollback per primitive: Worker=redeploy prior version; D1=additive-by-default so roll back via prior Worker (destructive ships down-script); Workflows resume against new code at last completed step.do; Vectorize model change=dual-write new index + flip reads + drop old, never in-place mutation.
invariants: Multi-tenant isolation is enforced IN CODE: every isolatable D1 table has tenant_id NOT NULL; ScopedDB injects AND tenant_id = ?; ScopedVectorize hard-wires namespace=tenantId; ScopedR2 prefixes ${tenantId}/. Cross-tenant access returns EMPTY, never error (no existence leak — drop-don't-error).
Raw env.DB.prepare / raw Vectorize / raw R2 bindings are importable ONLY inside packages/db; any reference elsewhere fails ESLint (a blocking CI gate).

There is NO internal shared HTTP secret. Internal Worker<->Worker uses Service Bindings; internal handlers still build a Principal from explicit tenant_id and go through Scoped*. X-Brain-Internal-Secret / INTERNAL_API_SECRET are explicitly rejected.

Environments != tenants: each Wrangler env is a full independent stack (own D1, Vectorize indexes, Queues+DLQs, R2, AI Gateway id, KV). Tenants are partitioned WITHIN one environment by tenant_id, never by environment.
Vectorize index dimension LOCKED to bge-m3 1024d. namespace=tenantId is enforced in code, NOT as a metadata index.
Metadata indexes (team_id/scope/visibility/embedding_model) MUST exist before the first filtered upsert (Phase-0 deploy-ordering rule).
Deploy order matters per environment: D1 create+migrate -> Vectorize create -> create-metadata-index -> queues create -> KV+secrets -> deploy (DO/Workflow classes register on deploy).

The enforcing per-tenant cost cap for the all-@cf/ v1 model set is the app-level token_spend 429 pre-check BEFORE env.AI.run; AI Gateway spend limits do NOT enforce for @cf/ (attribution only). A rate-limit hit degrades-or-queues, never 429s the interactive user.

memory_audit rows MUST be written in the SAME db.batch as the mutation (atomicity non-negotiable). memory_recall_traces MUST NOT block the read path — emitted via ctx.waitUntil, batched out-of-band to a separate trace store.
mcp_request_log writes use waitUntil and NEVER throw; never log bodies/PII (error_message is message only). Workers Logs fields include tenant_id but never bodies/PII.
Idle-session promotion sweep keys on last_activity_at, NOT ended_at (a missed Stop-hook leaves ended_at NULL; an ended_at predicate could never recover the transcript).
Same-dimension is NOT interchangeability: qwen3 and OB1/OpenAI 1536d vectors are RE-EMBEDDED, never copied.
Transcript/raw body lives in R2; D1 stores only r2_key + preview (asserted in prod smoke test).

The 15-canary isolation suite, the reranker output-shape gate, and the ESLint banned-binding rule are REQUIRED merge checks; a green CI pipeline is a precondition for merge; a new surface that bypasses Scoped* cannot merge.

Reranker output-shape gate is BLOCKING: until green for a given Workers AI version, rerank degrades to RRF order (a wrong index->chunk remap attributes the wrong chunk to a citation — a correctness bug).

Break-glass fails CLOSED for non-admins (403, no private content, no fallthrough to visibilityPredicate); admin break-glass MUST return private content AND write exactly one memory_audit row AND emit a breakglass_read alert — an unaudited/silent break-glass read is forbidden.
Each isolation test exercises ALL retrieval arms: vector arm, FTS arm, and live recall/think/injection paths — private content must not be semantically retrievable cross-user.
D1 is single-writer: audit rows stay in-batch (bounded by write volume); recall traces moved off critical path to avoid blocking on the single writer.

decisions.question: Per-model Workers AI request/min ceilings (embed/synthesis/rerank) are assumed-conservative and unverified-until-staging; the staging reranker gate is the first place a real ceiling is observed. Confirm and capture back.
decisions.suggestedDefault: Use embed ~300/min, synthesis ~100/min, rerank ~300/min as clamp targets; non-binding at 1-2 tenants. Observe real ceilings at staging.

decisions.question: Where do out-of-band recall traces flush — a dedicated traces D1/shard, or Analytics Engine for the aggregate view?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Analytics Engine for aggregate view at v1 scale; dedicated trace D1/shard only when write-throughput requires it (Phase-N).

decisions.question: Is apps/dashboard deployed as a separate Worker (requiring the Service Binding + DashboardRpc entrypoint) or co-located in apps/api?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Co-locate in apps/api for v1 (single Worker); add the separate-Worker Service Binding only if dashboard is split out.

decisions.question: Concrete write-QPS shard-split threshold against the D1 single-writer ceiling.
decisions.suggestedDefault: Do not pre-tune; observe at scale-up time. Non-binding at 1-2 tenants.

decisions.question: Production custom-domain hostnames (api.brain.example.com / api.staging.brain.example.com are placeholders).
decisions.suggestedDefault: Replace example.com placeholders with the real platform domain before production deploy.

AI provider abstraction (AI_PROVIDER=openai-compatible) reserved as deferred swap point at the chokepoints; future per-target external HTTP secret would use Secrets Store

section: §Appendix — Open Questions & Residual Issues (Brain Platform PRD)
summary: This appendix collects unresolved design questions and confirmed decisions across §1–§10 of a Cloudflare-native, multi-tenant "company brain" memory platform (Workers + D1 + R2 + Vectorize V2 + Workers AI + AI Gateway + Workflows + Queues + KV + Durable Objects; Clerk as OAuth 2.1 IdP). v1 is scoped to 1-2 internal-dogfood tenants on a single D1 database: the multi-tenant isolation model is fully built, but horizontal scale-out (D1 sharding) is deferred to Phase-N with tenant_shards columns kept forward-compat resolving to one shard. The system ingests documents (Workflow: extract→chunk→embed→KG-extract→index) and captures Claude sessions (capture_turn → idle/Stop promotion → fact extraction → writeback), exposes hybrid search (FTS + Vectorize + RRF + bge-reranker + cited LLM synthesis) plus an entity vector index, over MCP/REST/CLI/dashboard surfaces. Core build concerns are tenant-namespacing enforced in code at every storage handle (ScopedVectorize/ScopedR2/ScopedD1), append-only audit with R2 export, deterministic embedding-free dedup, and an app-level token_spend 429 cost cap.

components.name: apps/api
components.purpose: Primary Worker hosting REST API, the resolvePrincipal auth/scoping gate, and the search/synthesis pipeline; possibly also serves dashboard as static assets + same-Worker routes (topology undecided).

components.name: apps/dashboard
components.purpose: Tenant dashboard with two-level org-switcher + scope-switcher; may deploy as a separate Worker (needing a services[] Service Binding) or bundle into apps/api.

components.name: MCP server (stateless Streamable-HTTP /mcp)
components.purpose: gbrain-style stateless MCP transport; proposed as compatibility fallback.

components.name: MCP server (DO-backed McpAgent /mcp/:slug)
components.purpose: cf-graph-style stateful/SSE MCP transport; recommended primary; tenant resolved from signed /mcp/<slug> slug.

components.name: MCP Durable Object
components.purpose: Backs stateful/SSE MCP sessions; slug→DO key mapping must be pinned per (tenant, slug) to avoid cross-scope state bleed within a tenant (granularity open).

components.name: brain CLI
components.purpose: Command-line client; open whether it ships as a prebuilt binary (cf-graph 'cfg' style) vs npx, a tRPC client vs versioned REST client, and whether it ships a Claude Code plugin/skill. --tenant flag selects active tenant.

components.name: IngestWorkflow (document loading)
components.purpose: Per-document extract→chunk→embed→KG-extract→index pipeline; KG extraction currently in-Workflow for atomic 'indexed' status (possible split to a brain-kg Queue is open).

components.name: SessionPromoteWorkflow
components.purpose: Promotes a captured session: extract facts (whole-transcript) and writeback with deterministic supersede-by-source replace within one db.batch.

components.name: Enumerator (backfill)
components.purpose: Enumerates backfill items and creates per-item Workflows; bounds items-per-run; Workflow creates capped at 100/s and 50k concurrent (per-tenant fairness gate open).

components.name: brain-kg Queue (proposed)
components.purpose: Optional dedicated Queue to move KG extraction off the ingest Workflow step budget so a slow LLM doesn't hold the Workflow.

components.name: re-embed / backfill Queue
components.purpose: Carries re-embed sweep and backfill messages; messages/tick pacing unset; max_concurrency=10 as back-pressure.

components.name: Cron sweeper
components.purpose: Single */5 cron running idle-session promotion (keyed on last_activity_at), memory_recall_traces prune + R2 audit export, and re-embed enqueue pacing under a per-invocation work budget.

components.name: ScopedVectorize / ScopedR2 / ScopedD1 (L4 storage handles)
components.purpose: Code-enforced tenant-namespacing wrappers; ScopedVectorize always passes namespace=tenantId; ScopedR2 keys under tenant prefix; ScopedD1 gates by tenant_id.

dataModel.name: memberships
dataModel.notes: (user_id, tenant_id, role owner|admin|member|readonly, allowed_scopes). allowed_scopes NULL='*'=all (default); restricted list confines member, enforced at D1 gate + 403 on explicit out-of-grant scope. Lookup scoped WHERE user_id=? AND tenant_id=?; caching in KV is an open perf question.

dataModel.name: tenant_shards
dataModel.notes: Forward-compat sharding columns; resolve to a single shard in v1 (no fan-out). Phase-N scale-out trigger only.

dataModel.name: chunks
dataModel.notes: Per-chunk text + staleness/embedding-model tracking; FTS-searchable; possible embed_error column if index-now-with-error policy chosen. Backs citations via index→chunk remap from reranker.

dataModel.name: chunk_fts / entity_fts
dataModel.notes: Full-text search arms fused via RRF (chunk_fts) and optionally fused with entity vector search (entity_fts).

dataModel.name: pages
dataModel.notes: Unified node space for the link graph: doc_links.from_id/to_id reference pages ONLY (single-namespace). An ingested document IS a page; documents-as-first-class-graph-nodes deferred. DOC_GRAPH BFS uses nodeTable='pages'. visibility default 'world' (tenant-wide).

dataModel.name: documents
dataModel.notes: Ingested documents; backed by a pages row for graph participation. Default chunk/page visibility='world'.

dataModel.name: doc_links
dataModel.notes: Edge table; from_id/to_id → pages; single-namespace JOIN target; DOC_GRAPH BFS.

dataModel.name: entities
dataModel.notes: Canonical entity rows; embedded (canonical name + description) on upsert with per-row staleness/embedding-model tracking; D1 re-check after vector search. Deterministic dedup: key + alias union (no semantic/cosine dedup in v1).

dataModel.name: entity_mentions
dataModel.notes: source_kind enum chunk|document|session|page. Recommend chunk-level mentions for evidence precision (vs document-coarse); subject to D1 row-count budget.

dataModel.name: facts
dataModel.notes: Append-only with validity window (expired_at, superseded_by). Supersede-by-source: re-finalizing source_session_id soft-expires prior promoted fact set (expired_at=now, no hard-delete) in same db.batch as inserts+audit. idx_facts_session partial index. In-batch dedup on (tenant_id, entity_slug, kind, LOWER(TRIM(fact))). Trust grades: instruction/evidence/draft.

dataModel.name: sessions
dataModel.notes: last_activity_at NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), refreshed on every capture_turn; ended_at reserved for explicit close/finalize (may stay NULL). idx_sessions_open idle sweep keys on last_activity_at. content_hash for skip-unchanged.

dataModel.name: memory_recall_traces
dataModel.notes: Written per kept hit (think limit=12) + query traffic. Bytes pruned by cron older than N days (may roll up to per-(tenant,day) aggregates). Writes moved off synchronous read path via ctx.waitUntil, batched to separate trace store; Analytics Engine for aggregate view.

dataModel.name: memory_audit
dataModel.notes: Append-only; app code never UPDATE/DELETEs; ESLint/CI banned-binding control + R2 export as tamper-evidence. Audit rows stay in-batch (atomic) with fact writes. Break-glass admin reads emit an audit row + canary alert.

dataModel.name: memory_use_policy / provenance / review
dataModel.notes: Key off single polymorphic target_id (+ optional target_kind) across facts|chunks|documents|sessions (confirm vs per-target sidecars).

dataModel.name: brain_snapshots
dataModel.notes: Snapshot manifest; pin exact fact ids active at snapshot_at vs pin snapshot_at and resolve active facts as-of via temporal query (latter cheaper to store). Deferred feature.

dataModel.name: token_spend
dataModel.notes: Per-tenant spend ledger driving the 429 pre-check before env.AI.run; MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD default 400, per-tenant-overridable.

dataModel.name: chunk index (1024-dim)
dataModel.notes: Vector arm of hybrid search; namespace=tenantId enforced by ScopedVectorize. 10M-vectors/50k-namespaces ceilings non-binding at 1-2 tenants. No local emulator (in-test fake records namespace arg).

dataModel.name: brain-entities
dataModel.notes: 1024-dim cosine, namespace=tenantId. search_entities = scoped vector search (tenant + node scope/visibility gate, D1 re-check on entities), optionally fused with entity_fts. Pulled into v1.

dataModel.name: audit export
dataModel.notes: ${tenantId}/audit/${yyyymm}.ndjson, append-only, never rewritten; written before any trace prune so tamper-evidence survives.

dataModel.name: session-turn / document body offload
dataModel.notes: Lean turns in D1, long turns offloaded to R2 (byte cutoff undecided, e.g. >4KB → R2 ref). Pre-chunked imports: concatenate chunks → R2, or r2Key='' for purely-derived content (open).

dataModel.name: membership/session-scope cache (proposed)
dataModel.notes: Optional KV cache of the membership row per openbrains session-scope-store pattern to keep resolvePrincipal off a per-request D1 read (open perf question).

R2 (ScopedR2: audit ndjson export, session-turn/body offload)
Workers AI (env.AI.run: bge-m3 embed, llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast synthesis 24k ctx, bge-reranker-base rerank)

Workflows (IngestWorkflow, SessionPromoteWorkflow; 10k soft / 25k hard step cap)
Service Binding (services[]) — only if dashboard is a separate Worker
surface: MCP: think / query (hybrid search + cited synthesis, think limit=12)
MCP: capture_turn (refreshes sessions.last_activity_at, lean→R2 offload)
MCP: search_entities (scoped vector search over brain-entities)
MCP: get_session_context / brain_snapshots (deferred; stub vs omit in v1 catalog is open)
MCP transports: stateless /mcp (Streamable-HTTP) and DO-backed /mcp/:slug
REST: tenant selected via validated X-Brain-Tenant header (401 if unspecified, never first-membership default)
CLI 'brain': --tenant flag, search/capture/import commands (tRPC vs REST contract open)
Dashboard: server-side session-pinned tenant (cookie), two-level org-switcher + scope-switcher
Promotion-to-instruction action (gated to owner/admin; whether member can promote in own scope is open)
Break-glass admin read over another user's private content (audited + alertable)
algorithms: resolvePrincipal: per-request gate — determine REQUESTED tenant per surface (MCP slug / X-Brain-Tenant header / dashboard session pin / CLI --tenant), 401 if unspecified, re-check against memberships WHERE user_id=? AND tenant_id=?, bind Principal to exactly one tenant, enforce allowed_scopes (403 on out-of-grant).

Document ingest Workflow: toMarkdown extract → fingerprint (markdown-level, so skip-unchanged for PDF/DOCX runs after extract) → chunk (CHUNK_TARGET≈1200) → embed (bge-m3) → KG extract → index. Step cost ≈ ceil(n/10)+ceil(n/50)+ceil(n/5).
Embed-failure policy (open): hard-retry inside embed step (chunks not searchable until embedded) vs index-now-with-embed_error + reembed sweep catches up (FTS-hit-before-vector).

Hybrid search: FTS arm + Vectorize arm → RRF fusion → bge-reranker-base rerank (candidates ~40, total-context token cap; per-candidate truncation on long chunks) → index→chunk remap (BLOCKING CI gate locks {id,score} shape; defensive parse + degrade-to-RRF) → trust-grade boost (instruction 2.0 / evidence 1.0 / draft 0.6) → cited LLM synthesis (llama-3.3-70b 24k ctx).
Query expansion: extra LLM call on query/think path (open: gate on weak-result heuristic — top RRF < threshold or candidate count < N).
DOC_GRAPH BFS: traversal over pages only, nodeTable='pages', single-namespace JOIN.

Session promotion: idle sweep (idx_sessions_open on last_activity_at) OR explicit Stop → SessionPromoteWorkflow → whole-transcript fact extraction (§4.3 token-budget guard applies) → writeback-facts step: soft-expire prior facts for source_session_id + insert new + audit, all in one db.batch; in-batch dedup on (tenant_id, entity_slug, kind, LOWER(TRIM(fact))).
token_spend cost cap: app-level pre-check projects monthly spend vs MONTHLY_COST_CEILING_USD → 429 BEFORE env.AI.run (the enforcing boundary; AI Gateway spend rules do not cover @cf/ models).
Audit tamper-evidence: periodic append-only export of new memory_audit rows to R2 ndjson before any recall-trace prune.
Session-start injection (open): select instruction-grade memory (and maybe bounded high-notability evidence) under a token budget per a selection rule.
invariants: Tenant isolation enforced IN CODE: ScopedVectorize always passes namespace=tenantId; ScopedR2 keys under ${tenantId}/ prefix; ScopedD1 gates by tenant_id. Vectorize has no emulator — isolation asserted via in-test fake recording the namespace arg + staging integration test.
Principal is bound to exactly one tenant per request; membership lookup scoped WHERE user_id=? AND tenant_id=? so a multi-tenant user never over-matches.
Tenant resolution errors (401) when unspecified — NEVER a silent first-membership default.
allowed_scopes is enforced at the D1 gate with 403-on-explicit-out-of-grant (NULL='*'=all default).
memory_audit is append-only: app code never UPDATE/DELETEs it; enforced by ESLint/CI banned-binding control + R2 append-only export as the tamper-evidence backstop SC7 rests on.
Break-glass admin read of private content MUST emit a memory_audit row (exported to R2) AND trip a canary alert.

Fact re-promotion must be idempotent: re-finalizing source_session_id is a clean replace (soft-expire prior set, preserve supersession lineage), supersede + dedup done in the SAME db.batch as inserts + audit.
Facts are never hard-deleted on supersession (set expired_at, keep superseded_by lineage).
doc_links node space is pages-only (single-namespace); no unified pages+documents id space in v1.
Recall-trace writes must be off the synchronous read path (ctx.waitUntil/batched) so a read never blocks on the single-writer D1; audit rows stay in-batch.
Reranker output remap (index→chunk) is a hard BLOCKING CI/deploy gate — a wrong remap mis-attributes a citation (correctness bug).
token_spend 429 check runs BEFORE env.AI.run; AI Gateway metadata.tenant_id is attribution-only and does NOT enforce caps for @cf/ models.
sessions.ended_at is reserved for explicit close/finalize (may stay NULL); idle recovery keys on last_activity_at — so a missed Stop-hook is still recovered.
MCP DO key mapping must be pinned per (tenant, slug) to prevent cross-scope state bleed within a tenant.

decisions.question: Session-turn R2 offload threshold — what byte cutoff makes capture_turn deterministic (e.g. >4KB → R2 ref)?
decisions.suggestedDefault: >4KB turn → R2 ref

decisions.question: MCP DO scoping granularity: one DO per (tenant, slug) or per (tenant) with scope resolved per-tool-call?
decisions.suggestedDefault: One DO per (tenant, slug) with pinned slug→DO key

decisions.question: Cache the resolvePrincipal membership row in KV or read fresh from D1 each request (hot path)?
decisions.suggestedDefault: KV-cache per openbrains session-scope-store pattern

decisions.question: Add a cheaper pre-extract raw-bytes hash check at ingress (two-phase) vs markdown-fingerprint-after-extract only?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Two-phase raw-bytes hash at ingress as default

decisions.question: Embed-failure write path: hard-retry (not searchable until embedded) vs index-now-with-embed_error + reembed sweep?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Hard-retry inside embed step (current spec)

decisions.question: Cap chunks-per-document (split giant docs) or rely on bounded source sizes to stay under the 10k/25k step cap?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Cap chunks-per-document, split oversized uploads

decisions.question: Keep KG extraction in-Workflow or move it to a separate brain-kg Queue?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Keep in-Workflow for atomic 'indexed' status

decisions.question: Pre-chunked imports: reconstruct body into R2 or accept r2Key='' for purely-derived content?
decisions.suggestedDefault: r2Key='' for purely-derived content (saves an R2 write)

decisions.question: Rerank candidate count: dynamic reduction by cumulative token estimate vs fixed 40 + per-candidate truncation?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Fixed 40 + per-candidate truncation for v1

decisions.question: Trust-grade boosts (2.0/1.0/0.6) config-driven from day one?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Yes, config-driven so they can be empirically tuned

decisions.question: Gate query expansion on a weak-result heuristic (top RRF < threshold or candidates < N)?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Yes, gate expansion to save LLM call/latency/spend

decisions.question: entity_mentions.source_kind: point at chunk (fine-grained, evidence highlighting) or document (coarse)?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Chunk-level mentions for evidence precision

decisions.question: Machine-token tenancy: one token per tenant vs tenantId as per-request selector against an authenticated Clerk JWT?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Tenant-baked tokens (one per tenant) per plan implication

decisions.question: Can 'member' promote-to-instruction within own scope, or is promotion strictly owner/admin governance?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Strictly owner/admin

decisions.question: Single polymorphic target_id (+ optional target_kind) across facts/chunks/documents/sessions vs per-target sidecars?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Single polymorphic target_id + optional target_kind

decisions.question: Fact extraction granularity: per-turn (finer attribution, more LLM calls) vs whole/windowed transcript (cheaper, 24k-context risk)?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Whole-transcript with §4.3 token-budget guard on the extraction prompt

decisions.question: brain_snapshots: pin exact active fact ids at snapshot_at vs pin snapshot_at and resolve as-of at read?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Pin snapshot_at + temporal as-of resolution (cheaper storage)

decisions.question: Solo-user onboarding: auto-provision org on first login (org==user) vs require explicit create/join?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Auto-provision org on first login

decisions.question: Per-tenant Enumerator fairness gate for simultaneous multi-tenant backfill, or is Queue max_concurrency=10 enough?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Rely on Queue max_concurrency=10 back-pressure for v1

decisions.question: MCP transport: ship both stateless /mcp and DO-backed /mcp/:slug, or pick one?
decisions.suggestedDefault: DO-backed primary + stateless as compatibility fallback

decisions.question: CLI distribution: prebuilt binary vs npx, and ship a Claude Code plugin/skill?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Prebuilt binary + Claude Code plugin (cf-graph parity)

decisions.question: CLI contract: tRPC client (tight typing, coupled build) vs stable versioned REST?
decisions.suggestedDefault: tRPC client for v1

decisions.question: Dashboard: confirm two-level org+scope switcher; is org creation/self-serve onboarding in v1 or admin-provisioned only?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Admin-provisioned only for v1

decisions.question: Snapshot tools (get_session_context/brain_snapshots) appear as v1 MCP stubs or omitted until snapshot phase?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Omit until snapshot phase

decisions.question: Vectorize isolation coverage: in-test fake + single staging integration test sufficient, or dedicated staging-only isolation suite before each prod deploy?
decisions.suggestedDefault: In-test fake + staging integration test for v1

decisions.question: D1 down-migration policy: require tested down-script for every migration, or accept roll-forward-only for additive migrations?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Additive-by-default, redeploy-prior-Worker rollback (roll forward)

decisions.question: Dashboard deployment topology: separate Worker (with Service Binding) vs bundled into apps/api as static assets + same-Worker routes?
decisions.suggestedDefault: Bundle into apps/api (no Service Binding in v1)

decisions.question: Cron cadence pacing: concrete idle_minutes window and re-embed messages/tick values (currently */5, values unpinned).
decisions.suggestedDefault: Tune after Phase-4 load is characterized; keep */5 cadence

decisions.question: memory_recall_traces prune window N days (and whether to roll up to per-(tenant,day) aggregates).
decisions.suggestedDefault: Tune N once Phase-4 load known; aggregate rollup of old traces
